ebm rkye y`io dkdpim `eklio zxend ntpi dhn`d l` ahld zwpd fe, kci yidie xbilim api iyx`l kyiapd aiz dnwcy andxd ainipe l`kl ahdxd.
el` zwpe `l` atz, lti yxa dzxenez do atz, yno dzexd `io zxend pedbz `l` acbo zixey eivdx, yp`nx "x`yiz cbpj zixyj eivdxj ebe'", edcbo, yde` d' nipi zae`d, cxj `kilze de` lryez nnpe tz, ezixey eivdx, dm iio eyno, cxj yzizo dm akli, e`io `cm ryei lbr adm aicie, ltikj, l` dvxike adm philz icim `tle azxend, e`io vxij lenx aglio.
ebm atz glio l` dvxike `l` atz yxbilio ad zcix lwar qrecd rlidm, `al tz da`d akiqpio elgnpiez cwez y`io naxkio rlidm "dnevi`", lti y`io xbilio lwar qrecd rlidm, kne yiza`x aqino wq"g `io vxikim philz icim, kne y`io vxikim lcbo wcm ypryd tz, `s rl ti yzxenze di` no dzexd, `l` y`ipd xbild enveid kl kj aaiz, ltikj l` bfxe ayaild aglio.
enkl nwem, `m war qrecze rl tz da`d akiqpio elgnpiez cwez, kym ynerlz wairez fe lrpio "dnevi`" kj nerlz lrpio philz icim, yl` lglw aipidm ltz bnexd, kieo ywear rlidm kne rl tz bnexd, eiaxj bm ko axkz "rl philz icim":
a `tle tz bnexd, `m `ipe `ekl `l` tgez nkaivd al` wltzd iy ldqztw `m vxij philz icim, lti ytgez nkaivd `ipe pwx` `kl lrpio hn`z `klio, yntpi fd `ipe nhn` nywim e`klim `gxim ypbre ae, yp`nx "nkl d`kl `yx i`kl ebe'", egknim l` dvxike philz icim aglio nyem qxj zxend `l` a`kild el` apbird, etgez nkaivd kieo y`ipe pwx` `kl lrpio hn`d `io `kilze gyead `kild lrpio philz icim. ltikj, ihl icie el` iaxj. e`tle `ekl kl yde` vxij philz icim al` axkd.
`al `m `ekl kaivd, `tle ntxexio cwio iaxj "rl philz icim", y`s y`ipo nvhxtio lkaivd lhn`z `klio, nkl nwem, kieo y`ekl enkpiq lzej nrie yrex dpwx` `kl `s lrpio hn`z `klio `kilze gyead `kild lrpio philz icim. `al `m `egf gzikd bceld yiy ad kaivd eiezx e`ekl nnpd tgez nkaivd ihl al` axkd, de`il e`ipe `ekl kyrex dpwx` `kl lrpio hn`z `klio:
b `s rl ti ydyezd `io vxij philz icim, nkl nwem, `m `ekl cax yhaele anywd, aio ynhale rzd, aio ydid nhal nwcm e`ekl kyde` nhal enlglg yl` pzpba vxij lhl icie zgld, lti ydnywim rlelim lwal hn`d iezx, y`io vxikim dkyx. erec, y`s nywd glio ypbre ae qzm icim phn` epryd x`yeo lhn`d, enhn` `klio enywio `gxim akl yde`, ltikj dgnixe ad iezx nyem qxj zxend, edvxike philz icim lkl cax ynlglg anywd, `tle de` nywd y`io anipe zxend kll, kbeo nim ecay, nyem qxj zxenz iio eyno.
e`tle `io nhal `l` x`y dixw e`io icie pebrez anywd kll, bfxd yn` ibre ae. e`tle l`kl rl ici ks vxij philz icim, `m nim nveiio ltpie azej nil `e c' nilio, kne yiza`x aqino wq"b, bfxd yn` ihalpe aice kcxke, `e i`klpe aice kyde` nhal enlglg anywd, kieo ycxke ld`kl aic.
`al cax ycxke l`kl rl ici ks l` bfxe yn` ibr ae aicie. eltikj, `s `m pbr aicie cxj nwxd azej dks `io vxij philz icim, kne y`io vxij lyziz nywio, lti y`io cxkm lbr adm azej dkeq, elko `s `m a` lbr adm azej dkeq `io vxij philz icim.
el` rec, `l` `tle dyezd nim aice no dpdx, eko dheal `vare ayno `e cay ey`x nywio enevu `gx kj `io vxij philz icim, lti yl` zwpe kll philz icim lnywio `l` rl ici hael `klio, el` arpio `gx, de`il erwx cxj yziz dnywim de` akli.
enkl nwem, acay ra ex`ei l`kild, yxbilim ltrnim l`kl nnpe aic al` kli (`l` yde` hetg rl npz ldhtig, ywxei nywd lcaxi dkl, kne yiza`x) iy ldgnix yl` lwg nnpe a`var l`kl al` philz icim, ki iy lenx: n`gx yzwpe gknim philz icim l`klio yhaelo anywd kl yko lnywim rvno `m `eklm aice acxj `kild, el` devi`e nkll zwpd fe `l` dyezd aice `e akli lrelm.
eancipez `le l` pdbe xa dneo rm lhl icidm lkl cax yhaelm anywd. eiy ylnce rlidm fkez lenx, yqnke rl crz nwvz dx`yepim y`nxe, yl` dvxike gknim philz icim lcax yhaele anywd `l` ainidm ydie `eklio ahdxd, nd y`io ko rkye yklpe hn`i nzim. e`io lngez aicm, n`gx yiy ldm rl ni yiqnke, `al drwx kqax` dx`yepd. enkl nwem, l` iaxj "rl philz icim", yqtw axkez ldwl:
c `io pwx` nywd alyeo dzexd `l` f' nywim, ydm: dnim, ediio, edyno, edgla, edhl, ecay caexim, ecm adnd gid eres, ekbeo ynhal ae lxte`d ltweg pty. `al cm cbim `ipe pwx` nywd, ed`ekl cb rm cne `io vxij philz icim:
d eko y`x kl ni txez, `tle anwem yxbilio lryez nywim lyzid nqgihz `ifd txez, yde` gyea knywd lrpio yaz `ipe pwx` nywd lrpio hn`d, eko lrpio philz icim yzwpe nyem qxj zxend l`kld ahdxd:
e `tle txez dkaeyim `e ylewim enaylim a`gc nf' nywim `le yqgh dnywd ypalr adm `io rl dpqgh fd zexz nywd `l` zexz `kl, n`gx ydid aler a`kl, kne yiza`x aqino y"k. eko aayx ecbim ey`x nipi `klim dkaeyim `e ylewim a`gc nf' nipi nywim `le.
enkl nwem, l`kl d`kl fd dkaey `e dylew enayl arec ydxha ednxw hetg rlie yl` pzpba rc yl` id` ae hetg rl npz ldhtig vxij philz icim, ydxi `kl fd nhal anywd, ydnxw yl dkaeyim `e dylewim enaylim nywd bnex de` kyde` nf' nywim, xw nd ypalr nnpe azej d`kl alac iv` nzexz nywd el` nd yhetg rl baie, `s rl ti ypgya k`kl lrpio axkd, kne yiza`x aqino x"i, elko ipba `eze zgld nnywd yrl baie. e`s ygefx enzlglg nnywd dpqgh nzeke kypehle aice `io akj klem. `e i`klpe rl ici ks, `m de` cax ycxke l`kl rl ici ks:
f kl nywd ypwtd epwxy rc y`io ae hetg rl npz ldhtig iv` nzexz nywd, aio ypwxy rl ici ayel aio rl ici vpd. elko `io vxij lhl icie lnxwgz nxwgz diha rc y`io rl bad cay hetg rl npz ldhtig.
eiy `enxim ydcay `ipe iev` nzexz nywd lrelm, `tle pwtd epwxy lbnxi e`io ae nywd hetg kll. eiy lgy lcaxidm.
enkl nwem `m `io nim nveiim awl ltpie iekl l`kl aks `e aqkio `s `m cxj nxwgz fe ld`kl aic, y`io ldgnix kl kj afd elbfx yn` ibr, n`gx yiy nzixio lbr.
`al `m iy rl dnxwgz cay hetg rl npz ldhtig `io ldwl kll rl ici ks eqkio.
`j `m azglz ivi`z dcay ndyred, cdipe kyxqw dglez yl cay kci ldevi` dcay ndm, gya rlie l`klio alac el` lnywio, cdipe ygya kci lryez nnpe nxwgz ekiev` ad, `e lzpe lzej dzayil, `e lrxa ae `klio `gxim el`kle rndm acxj `kild el` lyzeze kll pryd `kl rl ici ngyad fe, el` ixcd rlie zexz nywd kll.
eiy gelwio afd. elko iy ldwl bm afd rl ici ks `e qkio:
g ekl fd anxwgz ydcay pkx atpi rvne azekd `e rl bad, `al `m `ipe renc atpi rvne kll al` zrxaz `kl, kbeo ypngd d`kl dnxwg lbnxi epryd bes `gc nny rm dcay, arpio y`io anxwgz fe cay hetg rl npz ldhtig pkx atpi rvne ali zrxaz `kl dpneg pzahl dcay nzexz nywd lbnxi epryd `kl, `s rl ti yde` hetg rl npz ldhtig, n`gx ypryd bes `gc nny rm d`kl drenc l`kild ex`ei l`kild, cdipe ydnxwgz rad wvz, y`io cxj api `cm lbnrd elalr aaz `gz ali dtej alyeo kll, yfe cxj yzid di`, `l` cxkd ldtkd nrh alyeo rc yzbir laiz dalird, yfe di` cxj `kild, kbeo ztegim ebcbcpiez (ywexio tleni"o ewxyi"o alyeo `ykpf) nxqwim enxwgim diha acay eprye gzikez raez.
(e`m di` xkd kl kj ycxj api `cm lbnrd elalr ali dtej alyeo kl yko y`io vxij philz icim, kne y`io vxij lyzid `tle yezd aice, kne ypza`x lnrld.
`j `m nhal ad `ifd `kl vxij philz icim knhal anywd bnex, n`gx ydi` xkd kl kj, `s rl ti yd`kl dngei pkx ad. ede` ydcay de` dxa, kne yiza`x):
h kl nywd `s rl ti ypwxy lbnxi, `m gefx epneg gefx ldiez zexz nywd rlie rl dpneg. elko rqd dnhbpz agn`d vxij lhl icie zgld, ydgn`d di` gla ywxey egfx epneg. `al dnhbpz ayno `io vxij philz icim, ydyno `ipe nf' nywio. eko nxwgz acay znxim `e cay dwpim (ywexio vewx).
e`tle lhbeo agn`d `io vxij philz icim `l` anwenez ynzikio dgn`d lacd zgld akli `gc e`gx kj nyinio `ezd lzej dhbeo kydi` ndzkz epnegd, ykax ixc rlidm zexz nywd wcm ypzpd lzej d`kl yde` dhbeo. `al anwenez ypezpio lzej dhbeo gn`d wxeyd y`io ad hetg rl npz ldhtig `io vxij philz icim lhbeo fd, ykieo ydgn`d wxeyd dizd `kl bnex, ekydzgild ldiez pnegd elv`z nnpd nywd dxi iv` lzej d`kl yde` nio dhbeo. ekl nywd da` l`kl nzglz ivi`ze `io rlie zexz nywd kll `l` zexz `kl, kne yiza`x aqino y"k:
i ndl diev` nayx vli `ipe pwx` nywd. e`tle decg dayx anim wcm dvlid, nkl nwem, ayrz dvlid pziay `eze lglegiz, eno dayx iev` ndl, ede` nlglegiz dayx rvne, e`ipe pwx` nywd:
i` dpehl icie ltxez pbeaim, `tle lghim eyrexim yzxenzo no dzexd dxi fd nbqi dxeg. e`s rl ti yvxij laxj qzm icim kyxez laxkd, `l` `m ko iecr ypbr anwem nhps.
and caxim `nexim? kypehl azexz giea philz icim kcxj phild ltz, `al `m pehl cxj pwiez, yxevd ldgnix rl rvne lpwez icie lkaec daxkd, `s rl ti y`ipe iecr ldm yem hn`d nzx:

` `qex l`kl al` phild, `tle `m xevd lkxj icie antd `e `ekl aks y`ipe pebr atz, bfxd yn` ibr.

`al `m iy axgew nil l`gxie eiezx nc' nilio ltpie ikxj icie antd ei`kl tze `e cax yhaele anywd, `e `ekl rl ici ks. eko `m de` qtw `m inv` nim azej c' nilio.

` pehl `cm icie ygxiz enzpd rlidm lkl diem kle, `tle yl` ayrz dcgw, ealac yl` iqig crze nynixzo npbird anwem nhps. e`m dpigo aazi icim `io lj ynixd nrld nfe. enkl nwem, `m pfcnpe le nim nekpim ltpie e`io vxij lhxg `gxidm hea yigfx eihl, el` iaxj.

`al `m `ipe pehl `l` lvxj `kilz tz yi`kl `gx kj `qex, ki zwpz gknim di` yzd` zks lphilz icim qrecd, nd y`io ko kypehl yl` lvxj `kilz tz `l` ynzpd rlido yiekl l`kl rl ici fd `gx kj, `ipe ngia kll l`kl rkye, e`gx kj kya` l`kl kax de` thex no dphild, el` gld rlie zwpz dgknim kll, yl` zwpe `l` apehl l`kild yi`kl nic, efd l` phl l`kild, `l` lcax `gx.

(eiy lgy lcaxidm ldwl aqtw axkez):
` dreyd vxkie exevd l`kl ihl a' trnim, x`yepd ihl phild y`ipd nkyxz l`kild, `l` lpwez icie laxj "`yx ivx", eypid phild kyxd laxj "rl philz icim", y`m ihl phild `gz kyxd eiaxj zgld "`yx ivx" (ntpi ypzgia ad zgld, erec ydi` zcixd), e`gx kj "rl philz icim" idid dtqw aio phild laxkzd. e`s `m iaxj zgld "rl philz icim" e`gx kj "`yx ivx", nkl nwem idid dtqw aio phild l"dnevi`", eiy `eqxim ldtqiw aipidm acaxi rqw erpio `gx, kne yiza`x aqino wq"e.

(`al aio phild laxkzd iy lgy iezx ldtqw, nhrm ypza`x aqino wp"g. erec, yiy afe yzi dtqwez: aio phild laxkzd, eaio phild l"dnevi`").

` l` `nxe "zks lphilz icim qrecd", `l` yl` izrqw aipzim a`ifd rqw rc yiqig crze ndqrecd. e`tle lnfb keq lwcey diem, `m nefbe agnio, yvxij lcwcw dxad yl` igqx `e iizx dxi fd dqg dcrz ndqrecd, e`qex lryeze aio philz icim lqrecd. ede` dcio lkl kiev` afd.

edrelm pdbe lenx nfnex "d' xeri" aio phild l"dnevi`" (eiy llnc rlidm fkez, lti yltrnim y`io dicim pwiez wcm dphild, ekieo yfde nrpio qrecd e`ipe gyea dtqw lcaxi dkl dwle ae yl` lhxg ldfdx l`nxe wcm dphild apwieo ktim):
` nvez ryd no dzexd laxj `z d' `gx `kilz nfeo, yp`nx "e`klz eyarz eaxkz `z d' ebe'". encaxi qetxim laxj ltpi kl `kild eyzid, `nxe: `m kyde` yar naxj kyde` xra l` kl yko? ekl dpdpd ndrelm dfd al` axkd k`le pdpd nwcyi ynim, yp`nx "ld' d`xu enle`d".
erl kl `kl enywd naxj rlidm axkd kellz lknd nipim, kne "aex` txi d`cnd" lkl nipi txez d`xu, e"aex` txi dru" lkl txez dru. geu no diio edtz, ynzej gyiaezo ware ldo axkd lrvno, ydiio devi`ede nkll txez d`ilo laxj rlie "aex` txi dbto", ntpi gyiaeze ynyng `z dla, yp`nx "eiio iyng laa `pey", edtz devi`e nkll txez d`xu laxj rlie "dnevi` lgm no d`xu", ntpi gyiaez dlgm yqerc dla, yp`nx "elgm laa `pey iqrc":
a ekaec daxkd di` lavr txeqz daxkd anwem ditd yatz, ede` nwem yp`td itd epzwyd itd diha n`tid, yde` nagx yatz, el` nnwem dxj, kbeo `m dai`e ltpie tz txeqd l` iavr n`nvrizd yde` xj, `l` iavr nlnrld yde` nwem dnagx yatz atz ylm.

ede` ydkl nio `gc, `al `m dylnd nyrexim edgzikd nghim, `tle di` txeqd whpd di` wecnz laxj rlid, de`il edghd nwcnz atqew, ayarz dnipio ypyzagd adm `xu iyx`l, ekl dnwcm atqew fd nwcm laxkd, kne yiza`x aqino xi"`.
e`s rl ti ko, ix` ynim iev` ici yzido, ynpig dtxeqd azej dylnd eaevr nyzido igc, de`il ebm dyrexd di` nf' dnipio edi` ylnd. `al `m dylnd di` yl yiteo, `s rl ti yde` nio yrexim, kieo yl` dfkixe dkzea atxey kne ghim `io vxij ldpige kll rm dtxeqd yl ghim:
a ekl fd kyxevd l`kl nyzido, `al `m `ipe xevd l`kl `l` n`gz ndo iaxj rlid, e`io le lgy ldypiz `s rl ti ydi` nwcnz atqew edi` gyead egaiad rlie, ynyem wcinzd egyiaezd `ipe ngia l`kl nnpd kll. e`io vxij lenx `m xevd l`kl dnwcnz atqew, y`io le lgy lypiz dylnd, y`ipe ngia l`kl nnpd nyem ylnezd. e`tle `m xevd l`kl txeqd y`ipd nf' dnipim `ipe ngia l`kl nnpd ntpi ylnezd egyiaezd:
b `m iy l`cm a' gv`i lgm e`io le lgm ylm llgm nypd ayaz igaxm igc aru yiy zexz kli rlie, `e ayem cax y`ipe nwvd, el` id` gaexm px`d, ecipe kylm lrpio lgm nypd, kne ycipe kylm lrpio rxeai gvxez, kne yiza`x aqino yq"e. `al `m iy le lgm ylm `io lqnj rl fd, ki iy lenx y`ipe pgya kylm `l` lrpio rxeai gvxez alac, yl` dvxike ae ylm `l` nyem `iad alac, yl` ia` `gc lenx: `pi pezo ylm e`zd pezo txeqd, eky`io gaexe px`d `io lgy lkj, `al lrpio lgm nypd `ipe pgya kylm rl ici gaex fd, kne y`ipe pgya kkx `gc lrpio hn`d ehdxd rl ici gaex fd.
eagl `io vxij lgaxe kll:
c yzi bleqw`ez dcaewez fe afe, yp`te epcawe azpex kj, epgzj no d`gz edypid py`xd ylnd hea iezx ldtxic dgzikd ndylnd kci yzd` px`iz ylnd, nnd yipigpd caewd ad `s rl ti ypx`iz iezx bceld, ydxi ylnd whpd wecnz laxkd ntxeqd bceld. nkl nwem, `l iavr nnpd anwem ydizd caewd agaxzd, yym px`iz ktxeqd, `l` iavr nnwem dylm yad. enkl nwem atxeqd nny `io vxij lfdx afd lavr avc dylm yad, ydxi nkl nwem txeqd di` nvc ykpbce, nd y`io ko ableqw` yptxcd ngaxzd, yylnd di` `l` ypx`iz ktxeqd anwem ypcawd eptxcd:
d dai`e ltpie l`kl yzi ylnez `e yzi txeqez, `gz bceld e`gz whpd naxj rl dbceld. ede` yyzido nnio `gc eyeez apwiez, `al `m dizd dwhpd tz pwid edbceld tz wax naxj rl dpwid. `al `m yzido yeez abclezo eyzido pwiez, xw yfe lapd iezx nfe naxj rl dlapd iezx. `al `m dypid y`ipd lapd kl kj di` bceld nfe iy ldqztw `ifd ndo wecnz laxkd.
ekl fd anio `gc, `al `m `gc yl yrexim e`gc yl kqnio, `s rl ti ydkqnio itim epwiim nyrexim naxj rl yl yrexim, lti ydyrexd ntxyz af' dnipim, nd y`io ko kqnio y`s ydo nio ghim enkll f' dnipim do, kne yiza`x aqino x"g l` dfkixm dkzea atxey kyrexim.
and caxim `nexim? kyyzido gaiaez rlie ayed, `al `m yl kqnio gaia rlie iezx iy `enxim ynaxj rl dgaia, eiy `enxim ynaxj rl nio f' yatqew, kne yiza`x aqino xi"`:
e dai`e ltpie l`kl tz pkxi etz yl iyx`l naxj rl yl iyx`l `tle `ipe pfdx ntz pkxim. e`m tz yl pkxi tz pwid etz yl iyx`l tz wax naxj rl `ifd yixvd, `m yzido ylnez `e txeqez eyeez abclo edo nnio `gc.
ede` y`ipe pfdx ntz pkxim, `al dpfdx nnpd l` iavr nnpd ayem rpio. eiy `enxim y`tle pfdx nnpd xy`i lavr nnpd `m di` pwid egaiad rlie, y`qex tz yl pkxim de` `qex wl, edzixede nyem gaea nved, yiaxj rl dgaia rlie, eiy lqlw dtz yl pkxim no dylgo rc l`gx axkz "dnevi`".
e`m nqa rne `exg y`ipe pfdx ntz yl pkxim edai` rne rl dylgo tz yl pkxi pwid, kieo yd`exg gtu l`kl ditd yl pkxim, e`i `tyx le l`kl al` axkd, eaxkze nhlz rl arl daiz ldevi`e ici geaze nnpe dzxd bm larl daiz lavr rlid nyem gaea nved. ekieo ydzx le lavr dzx le lkl qrecd fe, y`ipe kaec ynim yiaxj rlid e`gx kj itxy nnpd.
e`s rl ti y`io vxij laxj rl dgyea egaia `l` kyxevd l`kl nnpd, earl daiz fd ypfdx ntz yl pkxim `ipe xevd l`kl kll nnpd, nkl nwem, kieo y`m l` did pfdx nnpd dizd gyead egaiad le, `l` yd`qex nepre nnpd, lko `m inv` rld yiekl yi`klpd adzx, kbeo k`o yigaa ad dnved dzixe le gknim, ki kl axkez dpdpio zleid agaiaez, yrl gaiaez dp`ze de` naxj enyag ldwcey axej de`. `al `m al` `qex tz yl pkxim `ipd gyead rlie ntz yl iyx`l vxij laxj rl tz yl iyx`l.
eko ldtj, `m arl daiz `ipe pfdx ntz yl pkxim, e`io crze l`kl kl dqrecd `l` tz yl pkxi ki di` pwid, eapi aize `eklim tz y`ipe pwid yl iyx`l, `s rl ti yyzi dlgm npgim ltpie vxij lavr rl yl pkxim dpwid, de`il e`io crze l`kl `l` nnpd edi` gaiad rlie. e`s rl ti yapi aize i`kle nyl iyx`l `io fd klem, de`il ede` daevr:
f axkz "dnevi`" `io ld yrex, y`tle `ipe xevd l`kl `l` txex tgez nkfiz vxij laxj "dnevi`". el` pzpe yrex kfiz `l` aaxkz dnfeo ey`x axkez `gxepez, `al l` aaxkd x`yepd, y`qex ldpez ndrelm dfd `tle nyde al` axkd.
g and caxim `nexim? algm bnex, ycxj api `cm lwar qrecze rlie, `al nipi lgnim yiza`xe ltpipe y`io cxkm yl xa api `cm lwar qreczm rlidm `io naxkim rlidm "dnevi`" eaxkz dnfeo xw "aex` nipi nfepez" eaxkd `gz nrio yly, `l` `m ko `ekl yrex y`gxim xbilim lwar qrecd ltrnim rl yrex kfd, lti yaxkz "aex` nipi nfepez" kellz bm dlgm yde` nfeo, el` ware laxj "dnevi`" rl dlgm `l` ntpi gyiaeze, yqerc dla, ekl lgm y`io wearim rlie qrecd ahld gyiaeze, `l` `m ko iy ae kci lqrc.
eko c' axkez yl axkz dnfeo l` ware rlie `l` ntpi gyiaeze, yno dzexd did ci aaxkd `gz nrio b', ydxi l` p`nx azexd `l` trm `gz: "eaxkz `z d' `ldij rl d`xu dhad `yx pzo lj", ecxye ntqew fd: laxj rl dnfeo erl d`xu erl dnwcy, eci aaxkd `gz lklm, `l` ygknim zwpe laxj rl kl `gc atpi rvne. el` zwpe `l` algm yxbilim lwar qrecd rlie, `al nipi lgnim y`io xbilio lwar rlidm, `tle de` `kl eyar ndm, ypzgia laxj `gxidm no dzexd cie aaxkd `gz nrio b' yl zexd. `l` `m ko `kl yrex yapi `cm wearim rlie ky`eklim nio lgm fd anwxd, `al `m xa api `cm `io wearim rlie, `s rl ti yde` wear rlie ahld crze `vl xa api `cm.
enkl nwem, `m de` war qrecze rlie e`kl rne ayx ecaxim `gxim, kne ypedbim aqrecz lgm bnex, rc yyar, ebm `gxim xbilim lwar rlie `m `eklim rne y`x caxim kne y`kl de` naxj "dnevi`" eaxkz dnfeo.
eko `m de` yar nnpe lace ebm `gxim xbilio lyar nnpe kynltzio `eze a`ifd ltzo naxj "dnevi`" eaxkz dnfeo.
enk`o `zd lnc yyrex wairez qrecd d`nex k`o `ipe kyrex qrecd d`nex arxea, yde` kb' aivim, ydi` tgezd yaqrecz rpiim daxi`im eym qrecd rlid, `al `ipd qrecz xa api `cm daxi`im (ky`eklio nnpe lace al` ltzo ecaxim `gxim), (`l` kyrex rnx lblblz la' qrecez). y`m l` ko, nd derile k`o lyrx yrex y`gxim wearim rlie rm `ifd ltzo, dxi bm rl ici ltzo `io ym qrecd rlid atgez nkb' aivim tz. y`m l` ko, lnd dvxike ayzi qrecez yl rxeai zgenio kyzi qrecez tz, `m tgez nko x`ei la' qrecez rl ici ltzo, id` ci afd lrxeai zgenio, nwl egnx nltzo yl tz na' qrecez ynrxaio ae, kl yko dtz dp`klz aa' qrecez dlle.
e`m nzgld did acrze l`kl nrh eaxj "aex` nipi nfepez", e`gx kj pnlj e`kl yrex yxa api `cm wearim qrecd rlie iaxj `gxie axkz dnfeo, `s rl ti yl` axj "dnevi`" ltpie, kbeo yl` did kci wairez qrecd and ypy`x ltpie `gx ypnlj.
`al `m pnlj l`kl rec kyrex wairez qrecd nlac nd y`kl kax vxij lhl icie elaxj "dnevi`" zgld. e`io vxij laxj zgld axkd `gz nrio b' rl nd ykax `kl, lti ynvhxs rm nd yi`kl ldthx aaxkz dnfeo, kieo yypidm nio lgm `gc, nd y`io ko a`ekl cax yhreo axkd nrio b' ltpi qrecz lgm bnex, y`io nvhxtio fd rm fd ldthx aaxkz dnfeo, `l` vxij laxj zgld axkd `gz nrio b', kne yiza`x aqino x"g:
h e`le dm nipi lgnim y`io cxkm yl api `cm lwar qreczm rlidm: tz da`d akiqpio, elgnpiez, ehxewpio, ehxiz`.
tz da`d akiqpio iy ntxyim ydi` tz ryeid knio kiq, ynnl`io `ezd wcm `tizd acay `e avew"x `e ywcim `e `befim `e y`x kl nipi txez `e zalio, `s rl ti ydrqd rvnd pleyd anim lac, ep`tz azpex `e angaz al` yem nywd (kbeo rti"l tl`ci"o `e t`eei"cl` tl`ci"o). eakll fd nd yreyim atexim rqd xgad ekteld ennl`im `ezd aynynio.
e`tle `m dnlei de` xa n`c, erwx dkepd atz fe l`kilz dnlei, nkl nwem, nio cbo de` gyea e`ipe ahl lbai dnlei e`s rl ti yde` xa nnpe, elkj naxkio rlie "aex` nipi nfepez", ebm dnlei pthx aaxkd fe, yde` htl lnio cbo.
ede` ynzkepio bm ko l`kilz nio dcbo ydi` drqd yad dnlei, `s rl ti y`io fe rwx dkepd, `al `m `io nzkepio kll l`kl drqd, kbeo `ezm xwiwio cwio ypezpim nxwgz rlidm, ydcax icer y`io nzkepim kll l`kl drqd, xw ya`im lcaw dnxwgz rlidm kci yl` ihpte dicim ndcay dxi dm htlim lbai dnxwgz eaxkz dnxwgz tehxzo. e`tle `m `kl zgld dnxwgz epy`xe dxwiwim lacm.
`al ancipez `le ynpigim dnxwgz rl dcaypio (ywexio lrwe"j tl`ci"o) yheaim ln`kl, `m ko kepze bm ko rl `kilz dcaypio, enaxj rlidm "aex` nipi nfepez", etehx `z dnxwgz ydi` htld lnio cbo:
i ekl rqd ydnlei htl `lid, `s rl ti y`ekld lacd `gx yphl dnlei nnpd `ipe naxj rlid `l` "aex` nipi nfepez" el` "dnevi`", de`il eayrz `tizd dizd a`d akiqpio. `al `m `ipe `ekl `l` dnlei yphl nnpd lace naxj rlie axkd dx`eid le: "ydkl", `e "aex` txi d`cnd", `e "aex` txi dru".
ekl fd kydnlei de` ntxez ekiev` adm, ncaxim y`io cxj lwar qrecd rlidm, l` lltz adm `z dtz, el` lnfeo elyar, `l` `eklim `ezm lwpeg qrecd elzrpeb, kne yiza`x aqino wr"f, elko `io cxkm yl xa api `cm lwar qrecd bm ko rl dtz dnnl`z ndm. `al `m dnlei de` ncaxim ycxj api `cm lwar qrecd rlidm lltz adm `z dtz, kbeo ayx ecbim ebaipd eaivim eixwez (`e ycxj lwar qrecd rlidm lnfeo elyar, `s rl ti y`io nltzio adm dtz, kbeo kxea ezxcio ekl kiev` adm nnryd wcxd ydm nrwx dqrecd) kne yiza`x ym `io nlei fd nevi` `z dtz dnnl`z ae nzexz lgm bnex ydkl wearim rlie, lti ybm rl fe `io xa api `cm pnprim nlwar qrecd rlidm ntpi dnlei yad, kieo ydnlei x`ei bm ko lwar rlie qrecd lltz ae `z dtz (`e lnfeo elyar).
eiy `enxim y`io glew aio nlei txez lnlei ayx ebaipd ekiev` adm, elrelm naxj "aex` nipi nfepez", `l` `m ko `ekl yrex yxa api `cm wearim rlie.
edrwx kqax` dx`yepd. eix` ynim l` i`kl ndm tgez nyrex wairz qrecd `l` azej dqrecd lnfeo elyar, kne yiza`x:
i` eiy ntxyim ytz da`d akiqpio di` tz ypleyd acay `e agla egn`d `e ayno `e ayno `e ani aivim `e ani txez eiio `e ay`x nywio, geu nnim. e`tle rxa ad nrh nim, `m dxa de` ny`x nywio naxkio rlie "aex` nipi nfepez" eaxkd `gz nrio b'.
e`s rl ti ykl dnywio `io nevi`io drqd ypleyd adm nzexz lgm lrpio gld, nkl nwem, `io cxj api `cm lwar qrecd `l` rl tz ypleyd anim, ltikj `io ad gyiaez lgm bnex laxj "dnevi`" eaxkz dnfeo, `l` `m ko `ekl yrex yxa api `cm wearim rlie. eko `m rxa ad zalio dxad iezx nnim, `s rl ti ypleyd anim lac.
e`tle `m rxa ad zalio ecay iezx nwng, yknrh dcay edzalio dm rwx, edwng de` lcawm eldwtezm `io dwng htl `vlm laxj rlidm axkd dx`eid ldm, lti ynlac nd ydwng ncaw enwtd dzrxaz, de` nkyixe enzwpe bm ko l`kild, eno dqzm pzo dwng azrxaz fd rl crz ypidm, lcaw eldkyix, ekieo yde` nio cbo de` gyea e`ipe ahl azrxaz, kl ya` bm ko ldkyixe l`kild, elko naxkio rl zrxaz fe "aex` nipi nfepez".
e`m `kl yrex wairez qrecd naxj axkz dnfeo rl zrxaz fd (kne ynaxkio axkz dnfeo rl zrxaz wng zae`d awng whpiez yryd ndm tz, `m iy azrxaz kfiz akci `kilz txq wng zae`d, kne yiza`x lwno).
`al rqd ypleyd anim erxa ad nrh cay ezalio, `s rl ti yhrm dcay ezalio pxby arqd `io naxkio rlid "aex` nipi nfepez", `l` "dnevi`" eaxkz dnfeo, kieo ydxa nim. eko anrh gla egn`d eyno eyno ey`x nywio eni txez. erl ko itd reyim y`etio rebez (ywexio yn`l"u wek"o) llgm nypd, ki `io ym xw nrh yno:
ia eiy ntxyim ytz da` akiqpio di` tz ypleyd `tle anim, e`tle `ipd nzalz e`ipd nnl`z, `l` yreyim `ezd rebez iayez, ekeqqio `ezd lz`aeo el` kci ldyair (ywexio wikli"j).
elrpio dlkd, iy ldwl acaxi qetxim kcaxi klm, eatxh aqtw axkez, yl` laxj axkz dnfeo c' axkez rl nd ylqax` `gz ci aaxkd `gz nrio b', ki `io k`o qtw yl zexd `s `m `kl kci yaird yde` gia aaxkz dnfeo no dzexd, ydxi no dzexd ci lrelm aaxkd `gz nrio b'.
ekieo ynaxj axkd `gz nrio b' `io le laxj "dnevi`", yl` idie axkezie qezxez fe `z fe. erec, yaxkz "aex` nipi nfepez" kellz bm ko lgm bnex, `l` yntpi gyiaeze devi`ede nkll y`x nfeo eware le axkd atpi rvne, ekl y`io axex lpe yiy ae gyiaez lgm bnex `io ldevi`e ngfwze yde` akll nfeo aec`i.
e`s rl ti ydnaxj "aex` nipi nfepez" rl lgm bnex l` iv` ici geaze, de`il epyzpd lrlei egyiaez pyzpiz axkze, nkl nwem, aqtw lgm bnex iv`, yqtw axkez yl caxidm ldwl.
e`tle lkzgld `io k`o gyy axkd lahld, ykieo ydwle gknim acaxidm lv`z aqtw axkd `io fe axkd y`ipd vxikd, e`ipd lahld aec`i, kieo yiev` ad ici geaze, exy`i l`kl rl icd, e`ipe pey` ym ynim lye` el` lywx, ydxi naxj d' a`nz, yax` nipi nfepez, el` rec `l` ybm fd nfeo de`. `l` yky`ipe iev` ad ici geaze aaxkd fe dxi fe axkd y`ipd vxikd, epey` ym ynim lye`, `al l` lywx, `tle `m axj rl cax y`ipe nfeo kll.
ekl arl pty dxevd ldgnix rl rvne l` i`kl tgez nyrex wairez qrecd (`l` tz ypleyd anywio `e ni txez edi` nnl`z atxez ekiev` adm) ki `m azej dqrecd lnfeo elyar, kne yiza`x:
ib lgnpiez do xwiwio cwim (ywexio pial"y), eawvz ncipez `le (alipr"y), dpryim nzrxaz wng enim awcxd alild xkd n`c, eyetkim rl rli ixwez xgaim ep`tiz azpex rm drlim, `e yetkim rl ngaz y`io ad nywd ycipd kzpex, aio ydxzigd zgld e`gx kj ytj ad, aio yytj ad e`gx kj dxzigd. enrh nywd yneygio dngaz yl` zyxs drqd `ipe pwx` nywd.
`al `m iy ad nywd, `tle `ekl ndm yrex wairz qrecd naxj "aex` nipi nfepez" enrio b', lti yl` dizd rlidm zexz lgm nrelm, l` ayrz liyzm kieo yalilzm xkd, el` ayrz `tizm kieo yphbpe anywd, e`io lgm `l` d`tei el` nhbo.
e`tle `ezm y`io alilzo xkd n`c, kl y`io alilzo rad `io rlido zexz lgm ayrz liyd, el` ayrz `tid `m phbpe anywd. `al `m p`te azpex `e angaz ali nywd lgm bnex de`, enaxkio rlie "dnevi`" `tle l` `kl yrex wairz qrecd, ykieo y`io alilzo xkd n`c cxkm yl api `cm lwar rlidm qrecd ltrnim, `s rl ti y`io alilzm rad lbnxi.
eiy `enxim y`ezo yalilzo xkd n`c `io naxkio rlidm "dnevi`" eaxkz dnfeo ky`ekl yrex wairez qrecd `l` ky`ipo xwiwio cwio n`c `gx d`tid, kbeo yytj dxad rl drlim `e rl dngaz rc yprye raim wvz rl ici d`tid, `s rl ti y`ipo raim lbnxi, `al `m bm `gx d`tid dm xwiwim cwim n`c, kbeo `ezm y`etim acteq aio a' axflim `io wairez qrecd nerlz adm laxj "dnevi`" eaxkz dnfeo, lti y`io rlidm zexz lgm kll bm ayrz d`tid, kieo ydm xwiwim cwim n`c. eiy lgy lcaxidm, yl` l`kl ndm kyrex wairez qrecd ki `m azej dqrecd lnfeo elyar.
eko ahxiz`, cdipe ylewgim wng enim enrxaio eyetkio rl dkixd ede` nztyh ep`td iy `enxim y`io rlie zexz lgm kll, e`tle `ekl kyrex wairez qrecd naxj "aex` nipi nfepez" enrio b'.
(`al hxewpio cdipe yreyim bn` akixd epezpim ad wng enim nrxaim ad, `s rl ti yalilzd xkd n`c, nkl nwem kieo yrl ici d`tid pryim raim nerlz adm wairez qrecd laxj "dnevi`" eaxkz dnfeo krl lgm bnex. `al atgez nyrex wairez qrecd naxj "aex` nipi nfepez", de`il ealilze xkd n`c, e`io cxj xa api `cm lwar rlidm qrecd):
ic ekl nipi lgnim dlle y`io cxj xa api `cm lwar qrecd rlidm, `m a` l`klm azej dqrecd lwpeg qrecd elzrpeb, ldwl nkac dn`kl, kne yxbilio ykeqqio rebez iayez aqes dqrecd `e nipi nziwd `ipm pthxim aaxkz dtz, evxij laxj rlidm azgld "aex` nipi nfepez", kne yvxij laxj rl txez y`eklio awpeg qrecd, kne yiza`x aqino wr"f. `l` ydtz da`d akiqpio, lti ypglwe ad, eiy `enxim ylgm bnex de` nd yiy `enxim yde` tz da`d akiqpio, ltikj `io laxj azej dqrecd `l` rl nd ylcaxi dkl pwx` tz da`d akiqpio.
`al `m a` l`klm lnfeo elyar dxi dm a`im ngnz dqrecd epthxim aaxkz dtz, kne ypthxim kl nryd wcxd yazej dqrecd ya`im lnfeo `s rl ti y`io nltzio adm `z dtz, kne yiza`x ym.

` axkd xairiz tezgz a"axej" y`ipd kqnekd lgaxzd, lti y`ipd nkll axkz dnfeo `l` `gx kj pzeqtd, kypzpe dxebi aizx lwaexd zwpe axkz "dhea ednhia", "dhea" yl` dqxige, "ednhia" ypzpe lwaexd, ewared aaxkz dnfeo, ykld dec`d, eqnked `vl "aepd ixeylim", lti ykypgxad aizx pbcrd wxo iyx`l, e`io rzicd lgfx rc yia` ao cec.
evxij lenx ad b' nlkiez, `gz yld eyzim ayail axkz d`xu e"aepd ixeylim", yl` dfkix ado nlkez. e`s rl ti ydo qnekez laxkz "dfo" yiy ad nlkez, nkl nwem, kieo ydfkix nlkez aiz cec a"aepd ixeylim" `io cxj `xu yl` ifkix bm ko nlkez ynim ad, `l` yl` xve ldfkix nlkez ynim `vl nlkez aiz cec, lkj zwpe ldfkix kpbcd nlkez a"dhea ednhia", e`ba yzwpe nlkez kpbc "aepd ixeylim" zwpe bm ko kpbc axkz d`xu. e`le do b' nlkez: "nlj drelm", "`aipe nlkpe", "dnlj dhea".
eancxy `nxe yvxij lenx ad b' dhaez eb' bnelez. e`le do b' dhaez: "dhea" `', "ednhia" a', "de` dhia nhia ihia lpe" b', ydo pgyaio k`gz, fd npdb drelm. eiy ydie pedbim lenx: "de` dhia lpe, de` nhia lpe, de` ihia lpe", kcxj y`enxim dyly bnelez, ydo: "de` bnlpe de` benlpe de` ibnlpe":
a `s rl ti ydi` axkd `xkd `ipd geznz a"axej", ntpi ynzgld zwped anhar wvx: "axej `zd d' `lwipe nlj drelm, dhea ednhia" alac, e`gx kj deqite ad kl dcaxim dlle:
b `io lenx: "`l yakl iem eiem", `l` "`l akl iem". eiezx pkeo yl` lenx kll nlz "`l", ydxi kax `nx: "d`l `aipe". erec, y`m a` ligq dhad lym "`l", did le lenx: "dnlj d`l dhea ednhia":
c kyiy pkxi aaiz pedbim lenx: "klpe igc api axiz", ldevi` dpkxi nkll daxkd, y`qex laxj dpkxim, yp`nx "el` zgpm". eiezx pkeo lenx: "api axiz klpe igc", yl` idid akll daxkd `tle xbr, ky`enx: "klpe igc" wcm ynqim "api axiz".

`l` kynbir l"dnlj dhea" `enxim: "dgi dhea ednhia, `l `nz, cio `nz, yeth avcw, lewg ptyez anyth, ylih arelne lryez ae kxvepe, ki kl cxkie nyth, e`pgpe rne eracie, eakl `pe giaim ldecez le elaxke, becx txvez aiyx`l, de` ibcx `z dtxvd df`z nrlipe enrl `al fd lgiim elylem, dxgno eke'":

entpi fd pyzpd axkz dnfeo nkl caxim dhrepim keq, kbeo wcey edacld, axkz gzpim enild, yaklm axkz diio wecnz, ek`o naxj "aex` txi dbto" `gx axkz dnfeo el` ltpid, `tle `m l` axj rl diio azej dqrecd, e`tle axj, dxi kyphl dkeq aice laxj axkz dnfeo dqig crze nlyzez wcm axkz dnfeo, e`m did pnlj lyzez did vxij lgfx elaxj, ekieo yko, lnd `ipe naxj "aex` txi dbto" wcm axkz dnfeo? `l` lti yaaxkz dnfeo de` necd enyag laex`e rl nd y`kl eyzd de` qlew edqg dcrz rl nd yryd, e`tle rl axkz dnfeo ynaxj edkeq aice, lkj vxij laxj zks lyzize:
a kl cax dhreo keq l` ci a`gifz dkeq lacd ayrz `nixz `eze cax, yfd `ipe nrka kll acirac, `l` rwx nd ydhripe keq de` lyzez nnpe `gx `nixz `eze cax, yzd` `ezd `nixd krio yixd dp`nxz rl diio ynpqkio rl bai dnfag, ydi` yziz dnfag, `s k`o zd` p`nxz yixd rl yziz diio.

e `s rl ti yhrinz keq yl axkd ci aknl` lbnie, akeq yl axkz dnfeo hea lyzez xairiz, lv`z nici qtw axkd `gxepd, yknl` lbnie a`cm aipepi de` xa xairiz, yde` iezx nkfiz, enkfiz rc xairiz iy nqztwim `m vxij laxj axkd `gxepd, kne yiza`x aqino x" i .

f `m crze lyzez rec l` iaxj axkd `gxepd rc laqes. ede` ycrze lyzez rec nic, y`m l` ko iy lgy yn` izrkl nd yyzd, kne ypza`x aqino wt"c. e`m did acrze lyzez nic ehrd eaxj axkd `gxepd `io vxij laxj axkd x`yepd, kieo ydid acrze lyzez rec eaxj ahrez. `al `m axj anzkeo, `s rl ti ycrze lyzez rec vxij laxj axkd x`yepd, ykl axkd `gxepd di` qlew edqg dcrz lnd yltpid entqwz, de`il e`i `tyx lyzez arece naxj, kne ypza`x lnrld:
g `s rl ti ykl dnqaim iev`im aaxkz diio yaxj dnaxj axkz dnfeo, yde` nzkeo ldevi`m ici geazo, e`s yiy `ifd ydez rc yibir dkeq lkl `gc e`gc `io afd nyem dtqw kl yl` dtqiw acaex, nkl nwem, aqrecd bceld ydnqaim xaim e`io iecrim rc diko ibir keq yl axkz dnfeo, dxi kl `gc ndnqtwim `m ibir le vxij lgfx elaxj "aex` txi dbto" lrvne, ntpi yde` kpnlj, ntpi yayrz ynirze axkz dnaxj l` icr `m ibir le. e`m pzkeo aynirze y`m ibir le yiv` ici geaze aynird fe - iv`, e`io vxij lgfx elaxj lrvne:
` terlim ykixi iem dreyim nl`kd `vl arl daiz nwvxio aaxkz dnfeo, kci yl` lahl nnl`kz arl daiz, yayrz axkz dnfeo `i `tyx lrqw anl`kd, kne ypza`x aqino wt"b. kivc? axkd x`yepd kzwepd, ypid tezg aaxkz d`xu ekell ad "apd ixeylim" egezm aaxkz d`xu, ntpi yaxkz d`xu e"apd ixeylim" do cenez, lko kello aaxkd `gz, ynpio daxkez `ipo no dzexd, ki aaxkd `gz ykell ad nrio ylyzo iev` ici geaze no dzexd, kne ypza`x aqino wq"g, `l` nyd eideyr ecec eylnd zwpe nhar ylyzo, enyem ahel nl`kz arl daiz dwle. eaxkd xairiz yrwxd ncaxi qetxim - `io dterlim `enxim `ezd kll, aio ynaxkio, aio yyenrio nti `gx dnfno enaxj axkz dnfeo kzwepd dxi do rencio lnl`kzm kygezm axkz ixeylim.

erkye lrelm naxkio kl c' axkez, lti y`io cxj api `cm ldwtic akj, eno dqzm rl crz ko yekxim terlim, yiaxke kl dc' axkez:
` kax pza`x aqino wq"f yaxkz dpdpio `ipd cend laxkz dnvez y`gc nevi` gaxe aaxkze, `al aaxkz dpdpio ni ypdpd de` naxj arvne rl dp`ze, e`io gaxe tehxe `l` `m ko pware igc acax ywairez nerlz ae, ycxke akj, ywairezm nvxtzm ldiez pgyaim kbes `gc, eaxkd `gz lklm.

e`enx `gc ndm: "paxj y`klpe nyle", edypim `enxim: "axej y`klpe nyle eaheae giipe".
e`m dm ylyd al` dnaxj, ikel lenx: "axke y`klpe nyle", kieo ydm x`eim laxj alyeo xaim alrce. enkl nwem, iezx hea lenx: "paxj", yl` ldevi` rvne nkll dnaxkim. e`s rl ti y`nx "paxj", vxij de` lgfx eldkpiq rvne lkll dnaxkim, lbnx elgfx elenx `gxidm: "axej y`klpe nyle eaheae giipe", e`gx kj nzgil: "axej `zd d' `lwipe nlj drelm eke'".

e`s yaxkz dnfeo di` axkz dpdpio, eaaxkz dpdpio ni y`ipe pdpd `ipe nevi` `z ni ypdpd, lti y`ipe ngia aaxkd fe nyem rxaez de`il e`ipe gead rl gaxe, yikel de` yl` ldpez eyl` ldzgia aaxkd, kne ypza`x aqino wq"f, nkl nwem, aaxkz dnfeo kieo ykax pdpd epzgia laxj ngia de` ldvile nreo elaxj le.
`l` ydgknim `nxe, yni yl` `kl tz `ipe ikel laxj axkz dnfeo, y`io laxj axkz dpdpio al` dp`d, eqnke fd rl nd ykzea: "e`klz eyarz eaxkz", ni y`kl de` iaxj. e`tle `m fd y`kl eyar `ipe iecr laxj `io gaxe naxj le, yiy kg aic gknim lrwx cax no dzexd aya e`l zryd, erec yfd `ipd rwixd, yikel `gx l`kl rne elaxj le. `al ni y`kl tz `tle kfiz, kieo ynaxj rl dp`z rvne nevi` bm ko gaxe y`kl kci yaird.
`al `m l` `kl kfiz tz ynaxkio `gxie axkz dnfeo, `tle `kl zayil ngnyz dnipim ynaxkio `gxie nrio yly `ipe ikel laxj axkz dnfeo kci ldevi` `z d`eklim tz, `tle l` `kle `l` kfiz.
eiy `enxim yni yl` `kl kci yaird `ipe nevi` `z ni y`kl kci yaird. ehea lgy lcaxidm lkzgld, y`m api gaexd nwvzm `kle kci yaird enwvzm l` `kle kci yaird naxj `gc nd`eklim kci yaird eiev`im d`gxim. `l` `m ko yd`eklim kci yaird `io adm ni yiecr laxj `fi iaxj ni y`kl kfiz eievi` `z klm ici geazm (`m did yar kax wcm y`kl dkfiz, y`i `tyx le ldai` rvne lici giea yl zexd rl ici yi`kl iezx. `al `m `tyx le l`kl iezx iy lgy lqax` d`gxepd):
f e`m `kle klm kci yaird, enwvzm yze enwvzm l` yze edm z`aim lyzez hea yiaxj ni yyzd, lti yiy `enxim yno dzexd `ipe gia laxj `l` `m yzd `m de` z`a lyzez, yp`nx "e`klz eyarz", ecxye gknim: "e`klz" fe `kild, "eyarz" fe yzid.
e`s rl ti y`io caxidm rwx, yfd qnj arln` de` yqnke gknim lgia axkz dnfeo rl kfiz, yp`nx "e`klz" fe `kild, e`kild akfiz, "eyarz" fe yzid, `al `io dnwx` iev` nici tyehe, y`ipe gia laxj `l` ky`kl eyar e`tle l` yzd, nkl nwem hea lgy lcaxidm anwem y`tyx, yiaxj ni yyzd.
`al `m nwvzm `kle lyar el` yze enwvzm l` `kle lyar eyze iaxj ni y`kl lyar `s rl ti yl` yzd, kieo ydrwx kd`enxim ygiea axkz dnfeo no dzexd zlei a`kild kci yaird el` ayzid:
g ekl fd kynaxkim afneo kzweo gknim, ydnfno lac de` naxj enevi` `z klm ici geazm. `al rkye yklm naxkim algy rm dnfno `io lgy lkl fd, eikel laxj `s ni y`kl kfiz lac el` yzd, `s rl ti yiy `gxim y`kle lyar eyze.
`l` ykax pza`x aqino wt"b y`io lpdb ko, `l` iynre nti dnfno ltgez rc qiem axkz "dfo":
h ni ydid kax yar wcm y`kl e`kl `kild bqd, `m pdpd bxepe n`ezd d`kild naxj ltpie el`gxie, enevi` `gxim ici geazm `s rl ti ydm giaim no dzexd ede` `ipe gia `l` ncaxi qetxim. `al `m ptye wvd rlie e`io bxepe pdpd n`kilze `ipe naxj kll, l` ltpid el` l`gxid, lti yfe `ipd gyead `kild kll lkl nvez yazexd, aio lrpio nvez ryd, kne ypza`x aqino zr"e, aio lrpio nvez l` zryd, knd ykzape aqino zxi"a:
` ylyd y`kle edm naxkim afneo epkpq `gc yl` `kl, `m pkpq ky`nx dnaxj: "paxj y`klpe nyle" gia lrpez `gxie: "axej enaxj yne znic lrelm erc", eyea `ipe repd "`no" `gx "axej y`klpe", kne ypza`x aqino wv"d. e`m nfnpim aryxd repd `gxie: "axej `ldipe enaxj yne znic lrelm erc". ede` dcio `m did ym ky`kle el` `kl rndm.
e`m l` rpd `gxie kj, `e ypkpq kydnqaio repio: "axej y`klpe", y`ipe ikel lrpez: "axej enaxj", kieo yl` ynr y`nx dnaxj: "paxj" (e`s lcaxi d`enxim yni yl` ynr "axke" nylig vaex ikel lrpez rm dvaex k`o `ipe ikel lrpez rm dnqaio, ydm repim: "axej y`klpe", ede` l` `kl, elrpez atpi rvne bm ko `ipe x`ei, kieo yl` ynr) irpd `gxidm "`no", eyea `ipe repd `gx "axej y`klpe" ygefx dnaxj.
e`io vxij lenx aaxkez dbnexez yiy ado dfkxz dym, ygia lrpez `gxidm "`no" `s rl ti y`ipe gia adm.
e`m pkpq kydnaxj gefx e`enx: "axej y`klpe" iy `enxim yvxij lrpez `gxie "`no". eiy `enxim y`io vxij, ykieo ydnqaim y`kle dm yezwim `io rlie yem giea kll (eiy lgy lqax` dx`yepd):
a ekl fd kyde` l` `kl el` yzd, `al `m `kl kfiz ixw `e cax `gx, `e yzd xairiz n`ifd nywd, el` axj rcio axkd `gxepd epkpq `vlm ikel lrpez rndm: "axej y`klpe nyle", `s rl ti yl` `kl rndm agaexd `gz `l` aaiz `gx.
(e`tle pkpq ayrd ykl dnqaio repio repd rndm: "axej y`klpe", `s rl ti yl` ynr "paxj", kieo yrepd rm dnqaio yynre, lti caxi d`enxim ko a"axke"):
` dyny y`kl kfiz nfnpim rlie, y`s yl` war rvne aylgo rndm `l` renc enyny rlidm e`kl nrnc, ebm delj ea` a`nvr `kilze e`io le wairez kll rndm nvhxs rndm lfneo, ykieo ycxj `kilze akj fe di` waireze, nd y`io ko a`iy `gx, kne ypza`x aqino wv"b:
a kezi afno dfd `ipe nvhxs lfneo `tle de` gax, ykax pnpe rlidm ery`em kpkxim bnexim lkl caxidm (`al vcewi nfnpio rlie `m gax de`):
b rm d`xu `io nfnpim rlie. e`tle wx` eypd, el` yny zlnici gknim ldwyez eltxw ldaio nzekm hrni dnypiez rl axim dxi fd rm d`xu lrpio fd. erkye nfnpim `tle rl rm d`xu bnex, kci yl` id` kl `gc delj eaepd and lrvne, y`m die texyim ndm bm dm die texyim no dvaex lbnxi.
enkl nwem, ni y`ipe wex` wxi`z ynr ygxiz erxaiz `io nfnpim rlie, ykieo yxa rni d`xu wex`im l` yij lenx yid` kl `gc delj eaepd and lrvne `m itxye nigicim y`ipm wex`im. e`io vxij lenx ni yde` xyr ereax raxd atxdqi`, y`ipe nrld nrm d`xu afno dzlnec (e`ipe cend lkezim wcm ybfxe rlidm, ydm die ncwcwim anvez ydgfiwe adm, eanvez yl` dgfiwe `ipo nexcim eteyrim, `l` nryd `aezidm aicidm):
c pkxi `io nfnpio rlie, `tle pzkeo laxj `ldipe. e`tle bx ynl el` hal `io nfnpio rlie, y`ipe bx rc yinel eihal kx`ei.
ebx bnex ikel laxj `tle afneo ldevi` `gxim ici geazm, eikel lenx "rl ydpglz l`aezipe", lti yl`axdm pzpd d`xu lnexyd, e`axdm pwx` "`a dneo beim":
d `epo agl yde` thex nlaxj `io nfnpio rlie. e`tle ld`enxim y`m xvd ldgnix rl rvne lrpez elaxj dxyez aice, nkl nwem, kieo yde` thex `ipe nvhxs:
e pyim d`eklez rm ylyd `pyim ygiaim lfno giaez bm dm lfno rndm. e`m dm yly exve lglw lfno lrvno dxyez aicm (`m d`pyim dm tgez nryxd, y`ipm nfnpim aym. e`m vxikez ldaio lyeo dwcy, pza`x aqino wv"b).
`al pyim d`eklez atpi rvno thexez lfno, e`m xve lfno dxyez aicm. ede` dcio lracim. el` zd` gaexd yl pyim eracim nfnpim igc, nyem txivez dracim, `l` pyim lrvno eracim lrvno, ealac yl` ifnpe aym:
f eko `m zyrd `pyim api gexio e`yd `gz `e rac `kle igc `ipo nvhxtio ldylim lryxd lfno aym, `s rl ti ydm giaim afneo, ykl cax yawcyd `ipe `l` aryxd `pyim api gexio, kne ypza`x aqino p"d. e`io vxij lenx y`ipo nvhxtio ldylim lfneo aylyd, kieo y`io rlidm geaz fneo kll, `l` `m ko `kle rm `pyim ygiaim lfno lrvno.
e`tle `m xve lvxto `ipm xy`im, ntpi ypx`d ktxivez kypkx vxes pyim rm `pyim afneo, y`enx dnaxj "paxj" avxes klpe. e`tle a`yd rm arld eapd `io gaxzo p`d kynvhxtio igc. eko aracim yvxeto pkx iy afd nyem txivez, ydracim dm yheti fnd etxevim aiezx, e`io lapi gexio lvxtm rndm vxes dpx`d epkx kynfnpio rlidm.
nd y`io ko kyiy fneo al` pyim eracim, `s ydpyim edracim nvhxtio lv`z ici geazo aynird ndnaxj elrpez `gxie aaxkz dfneo `io afd nyem txivez, kieo y`io vxeto pkx kll aaxkz dnaxj.
`l` `m ko pyim eracim nfnpio igc, ylfd iy lgy ltxivez dracim apyim `s y`io vxeto pkx. ede` dcio racim rm whpim `io nfnpim igc, nyem txivez dracim anyka fkex rm dwhpim:
g `pcxebipeq `ipe nfno l` l`pyim el` lpyim, l`pyim yn` de` pwad e`ipe nevi`m ici geazm `m `kle kci yaird, kne ypza`x aqino wt"h, elpyim yn` de` fkx eiy ae nyem txivez. `al nfno de` lnipe, y`m de` pwad klm pwaez, eko ldtej.
`al hnhem `io nfno `tle lnipe, ki yn` kyiwxr fd inv` pwad, ekyiwxre `le inv`e fkxim, e`ipe nevi`m ici geazo:
h iy `enxim ywho diecr lni naxkio nfnpio rlie, ede` yibir lrepz dtrehez, yde` kao h' `e ao i', kl `gc lti gxiteze. elkl dtgez bcel nao e', `m de` gxis eiecr nrvne ali yilncede lni naxkio. `al tgez nao e' `s rl ti yde` gxis eiecr nrvne `ipe klem, ydxi l` dbir lrepz dtrehez, edxi de` kni y`ipe ao crz.
ewho `gx ydbir lrepz dtrehez nvhxs `tle lfno aryxd aym, `s ld`enxim y`ipe nvhxs lwciy el"axke" elwcyd, yaaxkz dnfeo dwle ad, de`il ekl `gc e`gc ikel lthx rvne ngiea axkz dfneo (yikel laxj lrvne), nd y`io ko awciy e"axke" ewcyd, ykl `gc e`gc l` did ikel lthx rvne ngieae ayem rpio vxij yidie klm api nved. `al a' whpim `ipo nvhxtio.
`al iy `enxim yaio lylyd aio lryxd `io dwho nvhxs rc yidid ao i"b ypd ylnez, y`f `s rl ti yde` who texg, cdipe ytxge ae a' yrxez el` pbnxe ayrexo, yde` kci lks x`yo lrwxo dwle ae lvxto lfneo aio lylyd aio lryxd, `s rl ti ylkl dnvez de` who, ede` yiecr lni naxkim. `al `m pbnxe qinpie kyrexo `io ncwcwio `gxie `m iecr lni naxkio, enfnpio rlie akl rpio, kieo ydbir lkll nvez.
eiy ngnixio e`enxim y`tle de` ao i"b ylnez eiecr lni naxkio, `m icer yl` dai` a' yrxez `xkez kyrexo `io lvxte l` lylyd el` lryxd. `al aqzm nfnpio rlie, yfneo de` ncaxi qetxim, eqenkio rl dgfwd yno dqzm dai` a' yrxez kyrexo azylem i"b ypd kcxj xa api `cm. eko pedbio ancipez `le yl` lfno rl who tgez nao i"b eiem `gc, e`io lypez.
ekl fd lrpio fneo, `al ldevi` `gxim ici geazm aaxkze lcaxi dkl `ipe nevi` rc yidid ao i"b ypd eiem `gc eicer ydai` a' yrxez kyrexo rl ici aciwd, `e ypznl` fwpe, yaxkz dnfeo de` no dzexd, eayl zexd `io qenkio rl gfwd fe:
i ni yapi `cm ngfiwio `eze lyehd, `m l` dbir lkll yehd ycaxe ae gknim nfnpio rlie. `al gxy eyehd ycaxe adm gknim akl nwem y`ipo api crz ethexim nkl dnvez cipm kwho tgez nao e', y`io nfnpio rlie lcaxi dkl, e`io nvhxtio l` lylyd el` lryxd.
egxy ycaxe ae gknim akl nwem de` y`ipe yenr el` ncax, `al ncax e`ipe yenr (eko `lm y`ipe ncax eyenr) (`tle dm ypim eiezx), kieo ydm ktwgim lkl caxidm nvhxtim lfneo, `m dm naipim enkepio lfd (`s rl ti y`io dgxy yenr axkz dfneo ed`lm `ipe repd).
and caxim `nexim? lfneo aryxd, ylcax yawcyd `io rpiz dnreh nrkazm, kne ypza`x aqino p"d, `al lfneo aylyd vxij ydypim iynre nti dnfno rc qiem axkz "dfo", ebm yirpe `gxie: "axej y`klpe ke'", e`m l`e `io k`o fneo kll, kne ypza`x aqino wv"b:
i` ni ypcede rl cax raxd `io nvxtio `eze lfneo, l` lylyd el` lryxd, yfde rpio pcei, ynxgiwim `eze enacilim `eze n`bczm. e`m pcede rl rqwi nneo, iza`x aiexd crd qino yl"c:
` ylyd y`kle k`gz ebnxe ypim qreczm e`gc l` bnx d`gc ntqiw rl kxge ldypim erepd rndm axkz dfneo, eyenr rc "dfo `z dkl", kne ypza`x aqino wv"b. e`m l`e de` l` iv` ici geaz fneo.
`al dm nfnpio rlie aio repd aio `ipe repd, kl yde` renc ym eyenr eikel lrpez. e`m `ipe renc rndm wexio le rc yizwxa `lidm eiekl lynr elrpez rndm, kne ypza`x aqino wv"c (nd y`io ko agxy y`ipe ikel lynr e`lm y`ipe ikel lrpez `io nfnpio rlidm `l` aryxd, kne ypza`x aqino wv"h):
a `al ypim `ipo giaim ldtqiw l`gc. ltikj, `io giea fneo gl rlidm kll rc yizxve ldtqiw l`gc elaxj. e`m l` xve ldtqiw efno de` rlidm el` rpe `gxie, `e yl` ynre rc "dfo `z dkl" l` ryd klem el` iv` ici fneo. ltikj, `s de` `ipe xy`i laxj rc yibnxe dypim qreczm eifno rlidm, ydxi kax pzgia afneo nzglz dqrecd `m dzgile ylyzm igc, kne ypza`x aqino wv"b.
e`m pzxve ldtqiw le efno rlidm e`gx kj a` `gc no dyew ewar rndm ebnxe qreczm rne `ipo gefxio enfnpio, ykax txg ndm fneo kyfnpe trm x`yepd. `al `gc dntqiw lypim e`gx kj a`e ypim no dyew eware `vle ebnx qrecze rndm gefx enfno rndm, yde` pryd htl lypim `le yl` fnpe rcio, kne ypza`x aqino wv"b. ede` dcio trm a' eb' `e iezx, ikel ldtqiw elfno rm kl ypim ya`e eware `vle e`kl rndm kfiz.
ede` dcio `m die zyrd waerim igc nzgld edtqiw `gc lypim ndm ikel d `gc lgfx eldtqiw lypim `gxim ndm, elgfx eldtqiw lypim, `al ypim d`gxepim txg fneo ndm kyfnpe dx`yepim, el` py`x fneo agaexd `m l` y`kle rec `gx fneo dx`yepim, kne ypza`x ym aqino wv"b, eym pza`xe kl txhi cipi "txg fneo":
b dntqiw lfneo `io vxij lgfx elaxj "dnevi`" kygefx lqrecze, y`io k`o dtqw edqg dcrz kll, ki bm aynirze axkz "dfo" dizd kepze l`kl rec eyl` lv`z aaxkd fe. eltikj, `m `gx kj pnlj yl` l`kl rec vxij lgfx elaxj axkz dnfeo.
`al `m l` did acrze l`kl rec tz xw txtxz iv` ici geaz axkz "dfo", enzgil axkez dnfeo naxkz d`xu. enkl nwem, ifdx yl` i y ig aipzim, e`gx axkz dnfeo iaxj nrio b', ydi` axkd `gxepd rl dtxtxz, ydi` ngnyz dnipio, ki l` pthxd aaxkz dnfeo, de`il el` axj ad axkz "dfo".
e`m `gx yiv` ici geaz axkz "dfo" pnlj lgfx el`kl tz vxij lhl icie elaxj "dnevi`" zgld, ykax ryd qlew edqg dcrz aaxke axkd `gz naxkz dnfeo (`al dqg dcrz lace `ipe fwew laxj "dnevi`", kne ypza`x aqino wr"h):
` bcel agknd yakl dnqaio, de` iaxj axkz dnfeo lklm, `tle `m a` aqes dqrecd. e`m xevd lzo xyez lwho laxj dxyez aice.
e`m dbcel nevi` lgd (ywexio dey"h) iaxj `gx, ki fd `io pkeo yitqiw trnim xaez eidid xeww e`gxim inzipe:
a gkm iyx`l wcm lkdo `tle y`ipe gkm kneze, `s rl ti yde` bm ko zlnic gkm. enkl nwem, hea yingl iyx`l dgkm rl kaece eiwcine dkdo laxj, el` iaxj ltpie, kieo ydkdo bm ko zlnic gkm. edreyd ko n`xij inim.
`al lkdo rm d`xu `qex ldwcim cxj gw enyth kdpd, nyem afieo dzexd, ki nrlzd bceld nnrlz dkdpd. `al `m dgkm pezo le xyez laxj kj al` gw enyth kdpd nzx. e`tle `m dgkm de` kdo edrm d`xu de` iyx`l:
b kdo eiyx`l ydm yeio agknd, nvez ryd no dzexd ldwcim dkdo, yp`nx "ewcyze", ecxye gknim: lkl cax yawcyd, klenx akl cax yix`d bcel de` nwcy, kbeo ltzg x`yeo awxi`z dzexd, eldiez x`y dncaxim akl waeu rm lcax elcxy zgld, eko aiyiad icax ax`y, eko aqrecd de` wcm laxj "dnevi`" eaxkz dnfeo, elzo le npd itd azgld lkl dnqaio. `l` `m ko iy iyx`l bcel nnpe agknd, `fi izpe ldgkm npd ditd zgld. evxij lfdx akl `le ydm no dzexd. `al kydkdo gelw `ifd yztez rm gaxe iyx`l `io vxij lzo le dglw ditd, y`io fd cxj kaec yihl glw ditd, ykl dpezo ripie aglw ditd `ipe xe`d qino axkd lrelm.
eanwem y`io kdo, hea ldwcim bm ko dlei liyx`l akl `le `m dm yeio agknd (edreyd ko n`xij inim. `al `io giea acax, yl` p`nx "ewcyze" `l` akdo, "ki `z lgm `ldij de` nwxia ebe'"):
c and caxim `nexim ydgkm wcm lkdo ekdo llei elei liyx`l laxj axkz dnfeo? kykl dnqaio dm arli azim e`io ym `exg, `e yklm `exgim e`io ym arl daiz nqa rndm. `al `exg earl daiz, `tle arl daiz de` kdo ebcel agknd d`exg naxj, kci yiaxj larl daiz. end axkd naxke? "idi xveo yl` iaey el` iklm arl daiz dfd l` arelm dfd el` arelm da`, eivlig akl pkqie, eidie pkqie nvlgim ewxeaim lrix, el` iylh yho anryi icie, e`l ifcwx ltpie yem cax gh` ereo nrzd erc relm".
enkl nwem, `m d`exg `ipe dbeo aripi arl daiz xy`i ldraix nnpe daxkd elzpe l`gc napi aize, `tle l` iaxkpe, kbeo yde` qnej rl ylgpe aykx, y`io vxij laxj larl daiz.
e`tle de` dbeo aripie exevd lezx rl axkze elaxj arvne dxyez aice:

he eixwez ypzayle agnu `e anywd ywexio a`xy"h, `e anywd `gx geu nnim `io naxkio rl dnxw axkz dixwez lti qax` dx`yepd, y`io ni ixwez gyeaim knezm `l` ntpi ynaylim adm rc yizpe hrm adm ei`klem bm ko, edxi `s `m l` did dayel `l` ayail dnxw lace l`kle ahrm dixwez ypkpq ae rl ici dayel l` die naxkio rlie axkz dixwez, kieo yiy ldgnu `e y`x nywd rec hrm yl rvne dxi hrm fd rwx, kne atxez dnxwgim acay yhrm yldm gyea rwx enaxkim rlidm axkzm el` axkz dcay, `s rl ti ypzayle kci yizo hrm adm. el` `nxe ynxw dixwez knezm, `l` anim y`io ldm hrm dp`d yl rvnm `l` lni yde` vn`, kne yiza`x aqino x"c. `al lqax` d`gxepd, `m rwx dayel ayail dixwez dxi dnxw ahl `vlm epgya knezm nypzpe ae hrm, `s rl ti yiy ldm rec hrm yldm:
hf kl dtxez, aio txez dru aio txez d`cnd, `io naxkim rlidm axkzm `l` acxj `kilzm, yrl crz ko pehrim `ezm, e`m cxkm l`klm naylim ntpi ydm heaim iezx naylim ngiim, `s rl ti ydm heaim ex`eim l`kild bm kydm giim `io naxkim rlidm axkzm `l` l`gx dayel, `al kydm giim naxkim rlidm "ydkl pdid acaxe".
`al txez ycxj `kilzm de` bm ko l`klm giim, `tle dm heaim naylim iezx ngiim naxkio rlidm axkzm, aio giim aio naylim.
e`tle txez ycxj `kilzm de` kydm giim el` naylim, y`io cxj xa drelm laylm l` pyzpiz axkzm ayail yaylm, ykieo ydbire lkll txi kydm giim `io dayel nahl zexz txi ndm. ede` yl` pyzpd hrnm lbxirez`, ydm heaim naylim kne giim, `al `m dm heaim iezx giim nnaylim, kieo ypyzpe ncxj `kilzm lbxirez` ahrnm ixce nnrlzm, enaxkim rlidm "ydkl pdid acaxe" kydm naylim:
if eko `m pyzpd z`xm lbnxi rl ici dayel nknez ydid arecm acxj `kilzm, kbeo ypzayle kl kj rc ypnege lbnxi, y`io rlidm z`x dtxi knez ydid arecpe gi yde` cxj `kilze pyzpiz axkzm, enaxkim rlidm "ydkl pdid acaxe".
`al txez ycxj `kilzm de` kydm naylim, `s rl ti ypnege cxj `kilzm de` akj, el` pyzpiz axkzm, `s rl ti ypyzpd z`xm lbnxi.
e`m l` pnege lbnxi ercio z`x dtxi rlidm l` pyzpiz axkzm `s rl ti y`io cxj `kilzm akj, kbeo znxim ynrko aic eryd ndm rqd l`gx ydevi` ndm bxripm, eko kl kiev` adm ny`x txez, `s rl ti y`io cxkm akj `s rl ti ko l` pyzpiz axkzm, enaxj rlidm "aex` txi dru", de`il el` pyzpd z`xm lbnxi.
(e`ipo cenez lwng yl ghim, y`tle l` phgo cw cw `l` rcio iy ae hrm yl ghim ex`eiim l`kild wvz giio, e`s rl ti ko `ipe naxj rlie axkz dghio ydi` "aex` txi d`cnd" `l` "ydkl pdid acaxe", lti ypyzpd z`x dghim lbnxi ahgipzm, `s rl ti yl` phgpe cw cw kwng bnex, nd y`io ko aznxim ekiev` adm ypznrke rcio z`x txi rlidm ) .
`al ynynio yhgpo, eko `bef ykzye aiezx rc y`ipe pkx andeze ez`xe naxj rlidm "ydkl pdid acaxe", de`il e`io cxkm akj.
eko whpiez naylim ypznrke cxj kli npwa ydo cwim n`c. `al `m nrj `ezm aks naxj rlidm "aex` txi d`cnd", kieo ynnyo wim, epkx ndezo ez`xo, erec, ycxj `kilzm akj.
eko txez ypkzye aiezx rc y`io z`xm rlidm, `m de` cxj `kilzm l` pyzpiz axkzm, kbeo (fpbai"l) `e aynim ygewim enrxaim rm (vew"x), `e nxwgim acay l` pyzpiz axkzm, ntpi ycxj `kilz daynim di` rl ici ygiwd.
eko excim ekiev` adm ntxez ycxj `kilzm de` lgzkm elxwgm naxkim rlidm axkzm `tle dm kzeyim aiezx y`io z`xm pkx rlidm kll, ki bm fd cxj `kilzm, n`gx y`io cxkm ld`kl kydm ylnim al` xweg.
`al `bef dnxwg acay rc y`ipe pkx andeze ez`xe naxkim rlie "ydkl pdid acaxe", de`il ecxj `kilze de` arece gi eylm. eko kl kiev` ae ntxez dp`klim giim.
(eaxkz dexcim di` "aex` txi d`cnd", lti y`ipo rwx dtxi, ki txgim dnd. eko dlepcxiq `ipe rwx dtxi).
eiy `enxim, y`tle txez ypnege lbnxi aayel e`io rlidm z`x dtxi kll, `e ypkzye aiezx rc y`io ndezo ez`xo pkx kll l` pyzpiz axkzm `s rl ti y`io cxj `kilzm akj.
e`ipo cenim lwng ghim yl` phgo cw cw, lti ydwng iy le rlei `gx yreyio nnpe tz, efd rwx txie, yrl crz ko fexrim `ezm, ltikj kieo ypyzpd eiv` nkll txi el` a` lrwx txie pbxr eixc nnrlz txi d`cnd laxj rlie "ydkl pdid acaxe", nd y`io ko atxez y`io reyio ndm tz `io ypeim nevi`m nzexz txi lbnxi lypez axkzm.
`al nipi whpiez ycxj api `cm lryez ndm tz, dxi ypeim nevi`m nzexz txim lcaxi dkl, `tle pyzpe `gx ayelm, y`f `io cxj lryez ndm tz. e`io vxij lenx y`m pyzpe areco giim, kbeo nipi whpiez hih`xw"i yhegpio `ezm wvz, ywexio bxeti"o, ereyio zayil nwngo krio ciq` naxkio rlie "ydkl".
(`al lqax` dx`yepd naxkio rlie "aex` txi d`cnd", ydxi fde cxj `kilze, e`cxa` ryiz tz nwhpiez `ipe cxj `kilze, ydxi naxkio rlie "ydkl pdid acaxe", kne yiza`x aqino x"g.
elqax` d`gxepd, nd ynaxkim rl tz whpiez "ydkl pdid acaxe", `s rl ti y`io ld rlei `gx fde ntpi ydtz pyzpd eiv` nzexz txi lbnxi, iezx nypei wng `e txez dpnegim `e dphgpim edpkzyim aiezx).
elrpio dlkd akl fd, qtw axkd ldwl acirac, `al lkzgld iaxj "ydkl pdid acaxe", lv`z lcaxi dkl:
ig `bef dnhbo acay, `tle ayle anim wcm dhbeo epyzpd hrne lbxirez`, eaxkze `f "ydkl pdid acaxe", `s rl ti ko kygefx epzwo rl ici dhbeo gefx laxkze ydi` "aex` txi dru". e`s yzweo fd de` rl ici dcay eaxkz dcay di` "ydkl", nkl nwem d`bef de` gyea rwx edcay htl `lie lzwpe eldkyixe.
eko akl nipi txez nxwgim, aio txez d`ilo aio txez d`xu. e`tle txez y`ipo x`eiim l`kild kll al` hbeo acay, kbeo excim ekiev` adm `io dcay gyea rwx `l` htl, ydxi `ipe a` `l` ldkyix dtxi l`kild, edxi fd ktxi y`io cxke l`kle gi `l` nayl, ynaxkio rlie axkze el` axkz dnim ypzayl adm edkyixede l`kild:
ih and caxim `nexim? atxez ypbnx ayelm, `al txez y`ipm x`eiim l`kild `tle rl ici dcgw kydm giim ntpi yl` pbnx ayelm edkyixm rl ici cay dcay de` rwx. e`tle `m nhbpo al` cay naxj rlidm "ydkl pdid acaxe", nhrm ypza`x lnrld. ltikj, `befim ynaylim acay arecm ixwim exkim naxkim rlidm "ydkl pdid acaxe", ydxi dm nxim e`ipm x`eim l`kild kll al` cay:
k wpim dnzewim yqeghio `ezo enaylim ninidm rc ypwt`ez eicne lnlg (ywexio vew"x), eko dnevu `ezo - iy `enxim ynaxj "ydkl pdid acaxe" krl y`x ni txez. eiy `enxim y`ipo cenio ly`x ni txez, de`il e`io dwpim x`eiim l`kild, e`io pehrio `ezm `l` ayail ninidm fde txim, enaxkim rlidm "aex` txi dru". eqtw axkez ldwl acirac, `al lkzgld iaxj "ydkl" lv`z lcaxi dkl:
k` tltlio areco xhaim ydm x`eiim l`kild iy `enxim ynaxj rlidm "aex` txi dru", kieo ydm bclim a`ilo. eiy `enxim ynaxkim rlidm "aex` txi d`cnd", de`il erwx phirzm de` rl crz yiziaye ei`kle xam ygewim k zalio, e`ipo p`klio atpi rvnm `l` nrehm ltrnim. eqtw axkez ldwl acirac, `al lkzgld iaxj "aex` txi d`cnd" lv`z lcaxi dkl:
ka `al tltlio iayim efpbail iay eko dvtxo (ywexio prbli"j) , ekl kiev` a`le y`io p`klim aiay `l` rl ici zrxaz `io naxkio rlidm klem ky`eklm atpi rvnm, y`io fe `kild yl dp`d laxj rlid axkz dpdpio. `al ru yl wpneo (ywexio vnxip"c) xbilio l`kle aiay, enaxkio rlie "aex` txi d`cnd", ki de` bcl rl d`xu kne wpim:
kb eko `bef ywexio neyw"h pe"q xbilio bm ko l`kle aiay, enaxkio rlie "aex` txi dru". eni yiy le ylyel epezo dneyw"h lzej dykx kci yirvx, `m `ipe vn` e`ipe yezd `l` lxte`d dneyw"h rwx edykx htl, enaxj "aex` txi dru". e`m de` vn` `e z`a lyzez dykx bm al` xte`d, `s rl ti ypezo lzeke dneyw"h lxte`d dykx rwx, enaxj "ydkl" etehx `z dneyw"h (de`il ealirz dneyw"h de` rl ici ykx, ealrcie l` did aelre).
e`s yiy `enxim y`tle yno y`ipe x`ei l`kild kll al` zrxaz, e`s rl ti ko `m rxae a`ifd nywd `io dnywd pgya rwx `l` `m ko dyno nerh yde` ahl azeke axa, kne ypza`x lnrld, ek`o ydneyw"h edykx `ipo pallim fd afd, `l` dneyw"h renc aripe azej dykx, `io lilj `gx xa ykx, `l` `m ko did nzayl ae, kne ypza`x lnrld, e`m ko did vxij laxj rl dneyw"h atpi rvne erl dykx atpi rvne nkl nwem qtw axkez ldwl:
kc kl txi yde` nqtw ae `m de` txi dru `e txi d`cnd, y`ipe iecr laxxe rl ti dqino yiza`x aqino x"b, `e txi dru ynqztw ae `m de` rwx dtxi `m l`e iaxj "aex` txi d`cnd". e`m `ipe iecr nd de` naxj "ydkl pdid acaxe". enkl nwem, `m de` cax yikel lthxe azej dqrecd de` hea iezx, y`f `io qtw kll.
ekl fd aqtw ypqztw le `gx ylnc, `al ni yl` lnc l` i`kl aaxkz "ydkl", ki `ipd tehxz dkl `l` acirac el` lkzgld ky`tyx, efd `tyx le lilj `vl gkm yilncpe dlkez axkez:
` rl txez d`xu naxkio "aex` txi d`cnd". eqino licr `ifd txi dru e`ifd txi d`cnd: kl y`le iphl dtxi epy`x drps wim lypd da`d enevi` dtxi dxi fd txi dru. `al kl ykle rvie lbnxi agxs egefxim evengim nyxyie `io txezie gyeaim txi dru, enaxkio rlidm "aex` txi d`cnd". ltikj, naxkio rl zezim dbclim aqpd "aex` txi d`cnd":
a and caxim `nexim? azezim, ydm heaim l`kild etxi bnex do, `l` y`io drps nzwim nypd lgaxzd, `al nipi txez bxerim dbclim a`ilpi qxw, kbeo ztegim whpim e`bqim whpim dbclim airx, eko rpai ddcq, `s rl ti ydm x`eiim l`kild `ipm gyeaim txi, e`io naxkio rlidm `l` "ydkl pdid acaxe", aio giim aio naylim.
`al `befim whpim dbclim airx txez gyeaim dm, enaxkio rlidm "aex` txi dru". eko txi ywexio axenarxi"o, etxi `cm ywexio rxtex"h. eko `ezm ywexio i`bicr"q dygexim. `al d`cnim bclim arya, eaxkzm "aex` txi d`cnd":
b `ezo zezim `cnim dpnv`im aznef, (ebm) iy (nio) dpnv`im agxs, e`io adm `l` yxs lac kpeq azej dgxvpim, enevvim `ezo efexwio `ezo naxkio rlidm "ydkl" krl y`x ni txez. e`s `m aelro rm dwltd edbxrio, nkl nwem, ripipe xe`ez ydwltd edbxrio `io x`eiim l`kild, `m ko `io laxj `l` rl dnywd yazekd:
c fpbail arece xha yde` x`ei l`kild naxkim rlie "aex` txi d`cnd" el` "aex` txi dru", lti y`ipe rwx dtxi, ki de` yxy zgz dwxwr. eko rl yxy ywexio l`wxi"u `m aelre:
d eko fpbail iay yryd nnpe nxwgz naxkim rlie "aex` txi d`cnd". eko tltlim iayim, y`s yprye x`eiim l`kild rl ici dcay `io dcay gyea rwx `l` htl, ydxi de` a` ldkyixm elzwpm. eko aynim ygewim enrxaim rm vew"x, kne yxbilim lkzy fpbail iay elrxae rm vew"x (ywexio n`bi"o teleer"x), `s y`ipo x`eim l`kild kll atpi rvno `io dvew"x gyea rwx `l` htl, yde` a` ldkyixm elzwpm:
e and caxim `nexim? anipi aynim ezalio, ycxko ld`kl rl ici hbeo acay, `e rl ici zrxaz vew"x `e cax `gx, arpio ydm gyeaim rwx, kbeo fpbail etltlio evtxo ekiev` adm. `al nipi aynim ezalio y`io cxko ld`kl `l` kynzalio adm dzayil, e`f dzayil de` rwx, e`io d`kild pwx`z rl ym dzalio kll, ek`le `ipo rencio l`kild kll, kbeo vihee`"x ekiev` ae `io ym txi rlie kll. e`s `m zwpe edkyixe l`kild knez yde`, kne yxbilio yvelio vihee`"x e`eklio lxte`d `io naxkio rlie `l` "ydkl", kieo y`io pehrio `eze rl crz l`kle kll, `l` rl crz lzo azayil. e`io vxij lenx `m hbpe acay `e yrxae rm vew"x. `al kyvelio fpbai"l lxte`d naxkio rlie "aex` txi d`cnd", kieo ypryd x`ei l`kild rl ici fd:
f vpeo naxkio rlie "aex` txi d`cnd", `s rl ti ydid qete ldwyez:
` rl cax y`io bcele no d`xu, kbeo ayx adnd gid eres, cbim egbaim, gla ebaipd eaivim, nim, nlg ecay naxkim "ydkl pdid acaxe". eko kndim ethxiez, `s ybcelm no d`xu, ynlglegiz d`xu dm bclim rl drvim erl dklim, kieo y`io ipiwzm no d`xu `l` no d`eix `ipm pwx`im "txi d`cnd", enaxkio rlidm "ydkl pdid acaxe":
a eko kl cax ypyzpd lwlwel pyzpd axkze dnigcz le, enaxkim rlie axkd dkellz dkl, ydi` "ydkl pdid acaxe", kbeo dtz yrtyd, ezayil ypyzpd vexze epzwlwl nrh. `al `m pzwlwl lbnxi rc y`ipe x`ei l`kild `tle rl ici dcgw `io naxkio rlie kll. eko tz yrtyd.
eko iio ydgniu rc yapi `cm pnprim lyzeze ntpi gniveze naxkio rlie "ydkl pdid acaxe". e`m pryd gnu bnex, cdipe yde` gfw kl kj ykynylikim `eze rl d`xu de` narar enrld xzigez `io naxkio rlie kll, ntpi yde` nfiwe, e`ipe x`ei lyzid kll. e`m rxae anim rc yde` x`ei lyzez naxj rlie "ydkl":
b eko kl cax y`io pehrim `eze rl crz l`kle acxj yde` `ekle naxj rlie "ydkl", kbeo txez giim ycxj `kilzm yrl crz ko pehrim `ezm de` l`klm naylim. e`io vxij lenx cax y`io pehrim `eze rl crz l`kle kll, kbeo dwex yl cwl elelai btpim eywcim dxkim, yrwx `kilzm di` wltzm dgivepd, e`io pehrio `ezo rl crz ko kll. nd y`io ko ay`x txez yl` pbnx ayelm, kne ypza`x kl fd aqino x"a:
c eko ygz yl zae`d ybeffio `ezd arecd ixw e`ekld naxkio rlid "ydkl pdid acaxe".
eko nipi fxrim y`ipm rencim l`kild `l` lzo hrm awcxd, kbeo yaz ekneo ekqax, `s rl ti ydm nzewim eheaim l`kild naxkio rlidm "ydkl".
eko kl nipi txez yaylm anim eryd ndm nywd, kbeo ykx z`pim eykx znxim naxkio rlidm "ydkl". e`tle ykx yrexim naxkio rlie "ydkl" el` "aex` nipi nfepez", de`il ede` vlel erenc lyzid, e`io naxkio "aex` nipi nfepez" `l` rl n`kl, kne yiza`x aqino x"g. e`ipe cend lnxw yl zayil ngnyz dnipio ynaxkio rlie "aex` nipi nfepez", lti ydnxw ahl rl bai dzayil yde` renc aripe, nd y`io ko aykx y`io ae klem n nnyez dyrexim. erec ydnxw rwxe lvxj ayel dzayil, nd y`io ko aykx, kne ypza`x aqino x"a:
d iy `enxim yrl ryai dycd y`ipo pfxrim naxkim "ydkl". and caxim `nexim? aryaim ydm bxerim nvc rvno, `al txez heaim dbclim al` fxird, kbeo `ezm ywexio i`bicr"q n`lip"y naxkio "aex` txi d`cnd", kne ynaxkio "aex` txi dru" rl txez gyeaim dbclim a`ilpi qxw, kne ypza`x aqino x"b.
eiy ni ydid pedb laxj "aex` txi d`cnd" rl dbclim a`xu e"aex` txi dru" rl dbclim a`ilo, `tle dm nipim bxerim kryaim ecenidm:
e iio yxige gnu ehrne iio rcio ym iio rlie, el` pyzpiz axkze. `al `m hrne gnu `s rl ti yxige iio naxkio rlie "ydkl", ydkl delj `gx dhrm:
f iio nayl l` pyzpd lbxirez`, `s rl ti y`io kl `cm yezd iio nayl kgi ntpi gfwe, nkl nwem, hrne exige dm nyagim iezx, eltikj l` pyzpiz axkze, enaxkio rlie "aex` txi dbto":
g eko iio ynrxaim ae cay etltlio, `s rl ti ypyzpd hrm diio rl ici dcay edtltlio l` pyzpd lbxirez`, enaxkim rlie "aex` txi dbto".
`al iio ypzrxa ae `gc ny`x nywio, `m pzrxa ae kl kj rc yptqc hrm diio `io laxj rlie "aex` txi dbto" `l` "ydkl", kieo ypyzpd lbxirez`. e`m pzrxa ae ykx z`pim yde` `ipe ntqic hrm diio delkim `gx dxa, `m dxa iio naxkim "aex` txi dbto", e`m dxa ykx naxkim "ydkl":
h iio ynfbe anim, `tle dnim dm dxa naxj rlie "aex` txi dbto", `m de` iio gfw yx`ei lyzid rl ici nfibd bceld kfe, ecxj api `cm lyzeze anwem iio rl ici nfibd fe, y`m l` ko ahld crze `vl kl `cm. e`m diio de` `gc nyyd anim, yiy anim yy trnim kneze `io naxkio rlie "aex` txi dbto" akl rpio, y`s rl ti yiy ae hrm iio `ipe gyea klem ayyd glwim nim:
i ynxi iio yanynxz ypzo rlidm nim b' ncez eiv` ndm c', ypznvd lzekm ncd `gz iio ndynxim dxi fd kiio nfeb, yko did cxj nfibz diio aini gkni dzlnec, ydie iipezidm gfwim, lnfbe ab' glwim nim, eltikj naxkim rlie "aex` txi dbto". e`m iv` tgez nc', `s rl ti yiy adm hrm iio wied` arln` de`, e`io naxkio rlie `l` "ydkl".
eiipez ylpe y`ipm gfwim kl kj nyrxim ayrex nfibz diio ya`eze nwem, e`m iv` tgez nfd naxj "ydkl". `al ynxim yl` pzo rlidm nim (`io diev` ndm pgya kwied` arln`), `l` iio bnex de`, enaxkim rlie "aex` txi dbto":
i` znc yreyio ngxvpim `e fbim ypezpim rlidm nim cipm kynxim, y`m l` iv` ndm iio kyrex nfibd ya`eze nwem naxkim rlie "ydkl". and caxim `nexim? agxvpim efbim yprvxe awexd, `al `m l` pcxke `l` axbl, kieo ypy`x adm lglegiz iio dxad, `tle pzo rlidm b' ncez env` b' `e tgez naxkim rlie "aex` txi dbto", yiio de`, ednim palrim afbim eagxvpim, eand yiev` iy ae iio nxad.

g `al ni yiy le pkxi ykix lypd yiryd kl dnl`kez dvxikez lycde a`ezd ypd, `s rl ti yno dcio did nzx ldpige lraec ycde ayaz, ydxi dpkxi ldp`z rvne de` nzkeo, kci yihel dykx ywvu le, y`s ydiyx`l iylm le `s `m l` iryd `ezd nl`kd ayaz, nkl nwem dxi ivhxj lryezd aiem `gx, ydxi ykxe lkl dnl`kez dvxikez lycde kl dypd, lkj de` reyd `ezd ayaz, kci yl` ivhxj lryezd aiem `gx (ebm `ipe px`d kylege yl iyx`l kne ykix iem, nhrm yiza`x aqno xn"c), nkl nwem ntpi nx`iz drio vxij de` lngez aice, ydxe`d `z dpkxi reac ayaz aycd yl iyx`l l` irld rl crze yde` ykix ypd, `l` icnd le yde` ykix iem.
el` `nxe yaykixez ycd `io l`qex ntpi nx`iz drio lti ycxj xa drelm lzo dycd a`xiqez, `l` kyd`nz ko de`, ypkxi fd dreac iy le fkez atxez ycd fe k`xiq, eiezx n`xiq, ydxi ykexd di` `vle ekl txezid yle, e`ipe pezo larl dycd `l` cax wvea, ltikj kyix`e `eze reac ayaz izle lenx y`xiq de` eiy le glw atxez dycd elheaz rvne de` nzkeo araecze, eigwxe `gxie arz dwvix `m d`nz de` ko, inv`e ya`nz iy le fkez atxez dycd, nd y`io ko apkxi yde` ykix ypd kyigwxe `gxie arz dwvix ix`e y`io le klem atxez dycd, izaxx ldm lntxr yl` did `xiq, ei`nxe yykix iem did.
enkl nwem, `m dycd di` geu lzgem `io l`qex ntpi nx`iz drio, kne yiza`x aqno xn"c, rio ym:
h dxgim cipm kycd, ynzx ldykixm lpkxi lypd `e lgcy yiraec eizrqw adm kl `inz yixvd eihel kl dykx lrvne, xw yizo ldiyx`l cax wvea, edpkxi reac `tle ayaz. e`io lgey lnx`iz drio, lti ybm dxgim cxj xa drelm lzo a`xiqez kne ycez.
`al dzpex cipe knxgu, y`qex ldykixe lpkxi iezx nlyyz ini dgl, lti ykyirqew ae dpkxi ayaz iy ae nyem nx`iz drio, yi`nxe yykix iem de`, yko de` cxj dzpex lrqew ae rl ici ykixi iem el` ldykixe el` lzpe a`xiqez, lti yivi`ezie nxaez eykxe nerh kne nxgu.
enkl nwem, dkl lti npdb dncipd, yanwenez ycxj xa `pyi drix ldykix dzpex `e dnxgu `e lzpm a`xiqez el` lrqew adm rl ici ykixi iem nzx ldykixm ym lpkxi `e lzpm le a`xiqez. eanwenez y`io cxj xa `pyi drix ldykix xgim el` lzpm a`xiqez `l` reqwim adm rl ici ykixi iem `qex ldykixm ym lpkxi `e lzpm le a`xiqez:
i e`s anwenez y`io cxj xa `pyi drix ldykix nxgu `e zpex `e xgim `e lzpm a`xiqez, nkl nwem `m iy ym `cm ydykixm `e pzpm a`xiqez ypd `gx ypd rc ypztxqm lxaim y`io cxke lykex terlim `l` ldykixm `e lzpm a`xiqez nzx le ldykixm lpkxi `e lzpm le a`xiqez:
i` `s anwem ynzx ldykix lpkxi nxgu exgim ezpex liezx nlyyz ini dgl l` dzixe le lhel dykx dnbir le arc iem dyaz `l` kydykix le `z iem dyaz adalrd rm y`x dinim, kbeo ydykix le lypd `e lgcy, y`nx le arc kl yaer zzo li kj ekj, `e `tle arc kl b' inim `e kl a' inim zzo li kj ekj, ypnv` yl` dykix le liem dyaz atpi rvne `l` adalrd rm inim `gxim, e`gx kj kydpkxi nylm le dykx nylm arc kl yaer kj ekj, `e arc kl b' inim `e arc kl a' inim kj ekj, pnv` y`io nylm le ykx yl iem dyaz atpi rvne `l` adalrd rm iem `gx:
ia `al `m dykix le linim ptxcim, y`nx le `pi nykix lj lypd `e lgcy earc kl iem eiem zzo li kj ekj, pnv` yiem dyaz nykx ldpkxi atpi rvne, ydxi kl iem eiem de` ykixez atpi rvne (eiekl lgfex ae a`nvr ypd `e gcy), ltikj `s rl ti y`gx kj nylm le dpkxi arc kl dinim aaz `gz `qex le lhel ykx dnbir lini dyazez, ydxi dpkxi ngya rne qkem inim ptxcim, enylm le arc kl iem eiem, pnv` ynylm arc iem dyaz atpi rvne yl` adalrd, e`qex lhel ykx yaz yl` adalrd, y`io nyzkxim ayaz, nyem bfxz nwg ennkx:
ib anwenez y`qex ldykix lpkxi nxgu `e zpex exgim ntpi nx`iz drio, `m rax edykix nzx le lwal kl dykx ndpkxi, ckieo yl` ryd `qex nrwx dcio `l` ntpi nx`iz drio `io wepqio `eze:
ic `s anwem ynzx ldykix lpkxi nxgu zpex exgim l` iykixm le arxa yaz `l` wcm lko, kne yiza`x aqno xn"e, rio ym dhrm:
he `s anwenez y`qxe ldykix nxgu zpex exgim lpkxi l` `qxe `l` kypwx` ym diyx`l rlidm, yicer entxqm lxaim ydm yl iyx`l, yx`e `eze nzrqw adm knd trnim ainez dgl. `al iyx`l ywpd npkxi nxgu zpex exgim el` dzrqw adm kll, `l` gfx edykixe nic lpkxi `gx dxi fd nzx, lti yrcio l` pwx` rlidm ym diyx`l, e`io k`o gyy nx`iz drio:
hf eko `m iy liyx`l aiz cixd agvx `gxz yde` `ipe cx azekd, eym iy nxgu a`ezd dcixd, `m kl inez dgl `io cxj yem iyx`l lxgeu a`ezd nxgu xw ykpi dcixd nzx le ldykixe lpkxi `e lzpe le a`xiqez.
e`io k`o gyy nx`iz drio, lti ykl ni y`ipe xegu a`eze nxgu kll ainez dgl `ipe iecr ynxgu fd de` yl iyx`l, ykieo yde` renc agvx atpi rvne e`io yem iyx`l cx a`ezd gvx, eykpi dnxgu yxegvio ad agl iecrio do y`io dpkxi ykix iem `vl diyx`l ekl dykx ypezpim arc dxgivd pezpe dpkxi liyx`l, `l` dykixe le `e pzpe le a`xiqez ekl dykx ypezpio arc dxgivd de` ldpkxi.
`al `m cxj yem iyx`l y`ipe nykpi dnxgu lxgeu ae agl, nzej yde` iev` epkpq ae iecr yde` yl iyx`l, e`gx kj kyiraex ym ltrnim ayaz eix`d pkxim xegvio ae igyec `z iyx`l arl dnxgu lenx ypkxi dnzrqw anxgu ayaz de` ykix iem `vl diyx`l:
` `s rl ti y`qex ldpig lpkxi yiryd nl`kd liyx`l ayaz, `s rl ti yreyd aykx `m de` reyd azexz ykix iem, kbeo yykxe diyx`l wcm dyaz e`nx le arc kl iem eiem yzraec li `zo lj kj ekj, `s rl ti yl` `nx le yiraec bm ayaz `l` nrvne de` reac vxij de` lngez aice, kne ypza`x aqno xn"b, `al `m de` reyd azexz walpez, ywal rlie lryez kj ekj arc ykx kj ekj, aio yreyd nyle, aio yreyd nyl diyx`l, ypzo le nnd lryez dnl`kd, kbeo ypzo le abc lztex ewvu le ykx, `e ypzo le gehio l`xeb le abc, aio ywal rlie l`xeb kl dabc, aio yl` wal rlie kll l`xeb kl dabc, `l` ywvu le arc kl `nd e`nd yi`xeb nzx ldpige yiryd kl nl`kze ayaz.
e`tle lkzgld nzx lzo le `tle arxa yaz qnej lgykd, rl cxj yiza`x aqno xp"a, `s rl ti yiecr ydpkxi iryd ayaz (eakj de` gtu), nkl nwem dpkxi `ipe reyd ayail heaz diyx`l `l` ayail rvne, lndx ldylim nl`kze kci lwal ykxe.
e`ipe cend lykix iem, ydykix iem `io dnl`kd yle kll, e`io le rqw ad, ydxi `io kepze araecze kci ldylim dnl`kd, ydxi l` rlie dnl`kd lbnex, e`io le zerlz kll adbnxd, `l` kepze lraec `z diyx`l kl diem kci yizo le ykxe, ltikj dxi fd kreyd yligez diyx`l, `al dwalo dnl`kd di` yle, ykepze araecze di` ldylim dnl`kd kci lhel ykxe, e`ipe kylege yl iyx`l.
enkl nwem, vxij lfdx yl` iryd aaiz diyx`l, eyl` i`nx le yiryd ayaz, ebm yiwveu le cnim wcm dyaz, ebm yl` izo le `l` `m ko arpio yiekl dpkxi lryez kl dnl`kd agl `m ixvd wcm dyaz `e l`gxie, kne yiza`x aqno xp"a, rio ym kl txhi cipim `le:
a and caxim `nexim ynzx ldpig lwalo pkxi lryez ayaz? kyreyd nl`kd acax dzley no dwxwr, ydpkxi ikel lryezd aaize `e anwem `gx y`ipe xyez diyx`l, e`io dcax pkx ydi` nl`kz diyx`l, e`io k`o gyy nx`iz drio. `al kyreyd angax lwxwr, kbeo ywal rlie lapez aiz liyx`l, `e lwvex ycd liyx`l, kieo ydwxwr bleid entxqnz lkl ydi` yl iyx`l pkx dcax lkl xe`d ybm dnl`kd di` yl diyx`l, ltikj `m de` azej drix `e azej zgend `qex ldpige yiryd ayaz, ntpi nx`iz drio, ydxe`d i`nx yde` ykix iem `vl diyx`l.
e`tle `m `io dcax ntxqm lkl ywxwr fe di` yl iyx`l, nkl nwem iy lgey lnx`iz drio yl ykpie, ydm iecrim ywxwr fe di` yle, e`ipo iecrim ydpkxi dreqw anl`kd de` walo, `l` i`nxe yde` ykix iem.
e`tle `m de` cx aktx aio dpkxim y`io le ym ykpim iyx`l, nkl nwem `m reyd azej zgem dktx iy lgey yn` ifcnpe le ym `exgim yiyaze `vle eix`e `z dpkxi reqw ayaz awxwr diyx`l, eigycede ydpkxi ykix iem `vle. ebm iy lgey lapi aize, ydm iecrim ydnl`kd di` yle, eigyce `eze ydpkxi de` ykix iem `vle.
`al kyreyd acax zley, `s ynwvz iyx`l iecrim ydnl`kd di` yl iyx`l l` bfxe gknim, kieo yxa dtrnim `io dcax pecr l`gxim kll, ynl`kz zley `io ld wel kll, nd y`io ko kyreyd angax yde` anwem blei entxqm, exa dtrnim dnl`kd bleid entxqnz lxaim, ynl`kz ngax iy ld wel, ltikj `m ltrnim `io gyy nx`iz drio `l` nnwvz iyx`l bfxe gknim:
b ekl fd kyreyd dnl`kd azej drix `e azej zgem drix, yikelio `pyi drix lilj lym ayaz, `al kyreyd dnl`kd geu lzgem, ebm `io rix `gxz yiyx`l cxim ad zej zgenie yl nwem dnl`kd nzx ldpige yiryd ayaz:
c `tle nl`kz zley, `m di` ntxqnz eicerd lxaim ydi` yl iyx`l, edi` pryiz anwem blei entxqm, kbeo apio dqtipd, ycxj lapezd rl ytz dpdx yde` nwem txdqi` `qex ldpige lryez ayaz, ntpi nx`iz drio:
d and caxim `nexim? aqtipd ekiev` ad ncaxim yym diyx`l pwx` rlidm, y`enxim cax fd de` yl tlepi. `al cax y`io ym diyx`l pwx` rlie, xw yreyd atxdqi`, epztxqm lxaim ycax fd pryd ayaz lvxj diyx`l, kbeo iyx`l yykx le pkxi awalpez lryez le klim gcyim eryd `ezm ayaz atxdqi`, y`s yiv` dwel epztxqm lxaim yreyd ayail diyx`l, nkl nwem rcio l` pwx` yne rlidm ldiez pwx`im klim yl tlepi, kieo yrcio l` a`e lxyeze nrelm, ltikj `s yreyd anwem blei entxqm `ipe vxij lngez aice nrwx dcio. enkl nwem, hea ldgnix elngez aice lgey lxpeo yrd, yl` ixpe `gxie lenx ypkxi reyd nl`kd ayaz ayligeze:
e `tle lryez azley, `m de` lvxj ngax, kbeo ltqel d`apim elzwo dwexez kci lywrm aapio vxij lngez aice `m de` azej dzgem, `tle reyd xgew ndapio, e`tle reyd aaize y`io dcax pkx yreyd ayail apio fd yl diyx`l, nkl nwem kieo yqeto lywrm adapio dxi cipm kdapio rvne:
f e`m l` ngd aice eryd ayaz awalpez iy ldzix lywrm aapio, eko daiz ypapd ayaz awalpez nzx ldiyx`l lkpq lcex ae, lti yiy ni ynzix walpez pkxi e`tle angax, ekc`i de` lqnej rlie acirac.
`al pkxi ykix iem yapd ayaz pkeo ldgnix yl` ikpq ae yem iyx`l lrelm. e`tle `m kyykx `z dpkxi linim dzpd rne yl` iryd aiem dyaz edpkxi ryd nrvne, (e)`m ryd lheaz diyx`l pkeo yl` ikpq ae yem iyx`l lrelm. `al `m pzkeo lheaz rvne nzx `tle larl daiz lcex ae, kieo ydzpd rne yl` iryd ayaz:
g awvz nwenez pedbio dzx ydwdl yekxim pkxim awalpez ltpez dfal no dxgea, edpkxi reyd lrvne e`tle ayaz, e`io geyyio lnx`iz drio. eiy ylnce rlidm fkez, lti ykax pztxqm dcax ycxj lykex pkxi awalpez ltpez dfal el` ykix iem, e`m ko `io k`o gyy nx`iz drio, kne ypza`x aqno xn"b lrpio nxgu zpex exgim, rio ym.
enhrm fd iy ldzix ldpig lpkxim lapez aiz dkpqz ayaz, `m de` nwem yntxqm ae cxj apio dazim rl ici `npim walpim, el` rl ici ykixi iem kne yde` axa dnwenez, yd`cxikl lace de` walo ed`npim reyi nl`kd yzgzie dm ykixi iem, yym iy gyy nx`iz drio.
enkl nwem, `io ldzix `l` ayrz dcgw, kbeo yiy gyy yn` izahl adnyj dfno apio aiz dkpqz lbnxi ngnz xyrz dpkxim. `al yl` ayrz dcgw `io ldzix, ntpi glel dym aripi dpkxim, ydm `ipm npigim lyem `cm lryez nl`kd atxdqi` aiem `icm, e`pe npigim lryez nl`kd ayaz ayailpe atxdqi`.
`al kaec dxgea `ipe pwx` rl ym diyx`l kl kj, e`io ae glel dym, lko pedbio ldzixe `s yl` ayrz dcgw.
enkl nwem, anwem y`io ym npdb `io ldwl `s akaec dxgea:
h ni yykx le pkxi lypd `e lyzim yikzea le `e yi`xeb le akl rz yivhxj azej fno nyj ykixeze, kne yde` cxj dyxim yiy ldm qetx nigc ykeza le kl rz yvxij, eky`io vxij de` ieya ahl nzx ldpige yiryd ayaz nd yved le wcm dyaz (xw yifdx yl` i`nx le yiryd ayaz) `m `ipe reyd aaiz diyx`l, lti y`io liyx`l xeg and yreyd ayaz, y`m l` iryd ayaz iryd `gx dyaz. e`s `m dnl`kd vxikd le anev`i yaz nic, nkl nwem `io fd pwx` xeg `l` dp`d arln`, exeg de` kbeo ydnl`kd dizd nzahlz lbnxi `m l` dizd pryiz ayaz, y`f de` nxeig dnl`kd rl ici ypryiz ayaz, ekne yiza`x aqno xp"a, eko `m iy le xeg `gx yxkeye nzxeg enzxad rl ici ypryiz dnl`kd ayaz, kne ypza`x aqno xn"b:
i and caxim `nexim? ky`io diyx`l nwtic rne kll `m de` ieya eahl l`gx yved le lryez dnl`kd, `l` aice lryezd akl rz yixvd, ltikj kyde` reyd ayaz lcrz rvne de` reyd el` ngnz diyx`l. `al `m de` nwtic rne rl ahele dxi de` reyd ayaz ngnz diyx`l, ltikj vxij de` lenx le yl` iryd ayaz. e`m `s rl ti ko de` reyd `ipe vxij lngez aice, ylcrz rvne de` reyd:
i` ekl fd ky`io dpkxi nykx le `l` lnl`kez nigcez, kbeo lkzea `e l`xeb akl rz yivhxj, e`gx ybnx dnl`kd de` ieya eahl, `al `m ykxe lkl dnl`kez yivhxj azej nyj fno ykixze `qex ldpige yiryd ayaz, lti ydiyx`l nxeig nl`kd fe ayaz, ydxi kyidid tpei `gx dyaz ivhxj lryez nl`kez `gxez. e`io ldzix ntpi ydpkxi reyd lheaz rvne kci lwal kl ykxe, ydxi `s `m l` iryd ayaz l` ipkd le klem, kne ypza`x aqno xn"b.
eiy nzixim bm afd, lti ydpkxi `ipe nrld rl crze ydiyx`l `ipe nkxige lryez ayaz eyl` ipkd le klem nykxe `s `m l` iryd klem ayaz, `l` de` reyd n`lie lti zne ldylim walpeze ywal rlie azglz ykixeze lryez kl dnl`kez yivhxke liyx`l akl nyj fno ykixeze, kci yiylm le kl ykxe nylm el` idid le rlie yem zxrnz.
e`io lqnej rl qax` fe (nhrm ypza`x ym), ki `m lrpio clwd nyem dtqc, kne yiza`x aqno yl"c, elrpio yligez `bxz, kne yiza`x aqno xn"f, rio ym dhrm:
ia iyx`l dwepd nkq `qex le lwal nkq ayaz, `tle dai`e cax n`kl y`ipe nwvd ex`ei l`kild, kbeo ydea` nzej dzgem, ede` cax y`io ae gyy yn` plwh diem ndngax `e yn` pvc diem `s rl ti ko `qex le lwal arvne, nyem yp`nx "nnv` gtvj", gtvij `qexim, kne yiza`x aqno y"e.
`l` yekx le pkxi awalpez, cdipe y`enx le lkyzbad n`d cipxim `zo lj kj ekj. `al l` iykex le pkxi liem dyaz, ykydpkxi de` ykix iem dxi de` kylege yl iyx`l, nd y`io ko awalpez y`ipe kylege yl iyx`l, `l` lrvne de` hexg kci ldxaez ykxe.
e`s rl ti ydiyx`l wear le nl`kze yiryd ayaz `io afd nyem `nixd lpkxi yaez, lti ywalz dnkq `io ad `qex `tle liyx`l `l` nyem yaez, edxi fd yaez cyaez, yiy nzixio `eze anwem dtqc, kne yiza`x aqno y"f. e`s yiy `eqxio `s anwem dtqc `m l` lvxj nved kne yiza`x ym, nkl nwem k`o gyea cax nved, y`m l` ihel dnkq ndpkxi ayaz l` iekl lbaeze `gx dyaz, eiyzwr dnneo aic dpkxi, edxi de` reyd nved and ynvil dnneo nicm, kne yiza`x aiexd crd qno wn"h eyr"a:
ib `tle `m de` nkq yvxij lryez ae nl`kd bnexd, kbeo yvxij lkzea `s rl ti ko nzx lenx lpkxi yizrqw ae ayaz awalpez, lti y`cm adel rl nnepe, e`m l` pzix le `nixd lpkxi ia` ldzrqw arvne, eyn` iykg eikzea, ltikj nzixim le `qex `nixd lpkxi yde` ncaxi qetxim kci yl` ia` lici kziad d`qexd no dzexd:
ic eko nzx le ldykix lpkxi `z dnkq yihel lrvne nd yibad ayaz do xa do nrh ede` izo liyx`l cax wvea, ypnv` yde` hexg lrvne, e`ipe kylege yl iyx`l.
ekynykix dnkq lpkxi, eko kyyekx le dpkxi awalpez `io geyyio lnx`iz drio ydxe`d i`nx ykix iem de` `vle, lti yanwem dtqc bcel l` bfxe rl nx`iz drio. e`s `m ltrnim de` dtqc nerh, nkl nwem kieo yrl dxa cxj ldiez dtqc bcel anpirz walz dnkq ayazez l` glwe gknim, edzixe lbnxi bfxd fe yl nx`iz drio ankq eakl kiev` afd ycxj ldiez ym dtqc bcel rl dxa:
he ekynykix dnkq lpkxi ikel ldykix le liem dyaz alac yl` adalrd rm y`x dinim. e`ipe cend lnxgu y`qex ldykixe lyaz alac kci yl` ihel ykx ayaz yl` adalrd, lti ydnxgu bete wpei le `s aiem dyaz, ekydpkxi pezo le ykx arc nxgu yle ydid nykx le liem dyaz dxi nyzkx diyx`l anxgu yle ayaz, edxi fd pwx` ykx yaz, e`qex lhle yl` adalrd, nd y`io ko ankq ekiev` ae ykydykixe lpkxi liem dyaz dxi nkxe le lbnxi liem fd, e`io k`o ykx yaz kll, y`io dpkxi pezo le ykx kll, `l` wpd nnpe lbnxi liem fd, edxi fd cend lni yiecr yiai`e le qgexd ayaz enekxd lpkxi nrxa yaz yiwalpd lngx lrvne, y`io afd nyem ykx yaz:
