ig iyx`l ylwg zpex lnykeo, ewal rlie dpkxi ynd yirld ykx dzpex izo kle ldiyx`l axaiz nrezie nzx lwal nnpe bm ykx dyaz `tle yl` adalrd, lti ybes dzpex de` yl dpkxi, e`io ldiyx`l glw ae kll, ebm `io diyx`l `enx le yiryd ayaz, `l` dpkxi nrvne de` reyd lheaze, kci lylm geae ypzgia lzo ykx dzpex ldiyx`l axaiz nrezie:
ih `m `te pkxim ayaz azpexe yl iyx`l arl kxge epzpe le ykx dzpex `qex ldpez nnpe relniz, aio le aio l`gxim, ntpi yde` ykx yaz:
` nzx ldy`il klim eldykixm lpkxi e`s rl ti ydpkxi reyd adm nl`kd ayaz, ntpi y`io `pe nveio rl yaizz dklim ylpe yl` iryd adm dpkxi nl`kd ayaz, `e yl` zryd ado nl`kd ayaz n`lid, kne yiza`x aqno xp"a (elrpio ldykix cax yl txdqi`, rio qno xn"b).
ekypehl dykx l` ihel ykx dyaz `l` adalrd, kbeo `m dykix le lyaer `e lgcy ikel lhel dykx `s yykx dyaz nalr ae, `al `m dykix le linim ptxcim arc kl iem eiem kj ekj l` ihel nnpe ykx dnbir lini dyaz, kne ypza`x aqno xn"b, rio ym.
e`tle `m dykix le iyx`l klim y`io reyim adm nl`kd kll, e`tle dykix le gcx lcex ae l` ihel ykx yaz `l` adalrd (rio qno y"e):
a iy `enxim ydklim yreyim adm nl`kd, kbeo xgim anwem ynzx ldykixm lpkxi, kne ypza`x aqno xn"b, engxyd ekiev` ado ny`x kli `npez `qex ldykixm lpkxi arxa yaz, ckieo yiy xeg ldiyx`l and ydklim pykxim lpkxi bm aiem dyaz, ki icer de` `s ynykixm le lyaer `e lgcy `m did nykix le geu nyazez yl` did xy`i lryez adm nl`kd bm ayaz did dpkxi tegz le nrh nykixez ypezo rkye kynykix le qzm eiy le xyez lryez bm ayaz, ltikj kydpkxi reyd nl`kd ayaz qnej liem ydykixm le cdipe rxa yaz dxi px`d k`le reyd ayligez diyx`l yvede lryez ayaz kydykixm le `znel, kieo yiy xeg liyx`l and yde` xy`i lryez ayaz. eko rwx:
b `al ldy`il le klim yreyim adm nl`kd nzx `tle arxa yaz qnej lgykd, ckieo y`io xeg liyx`l and ydpkxi xy`i lryez adm ayaz `io px`d k`le reyd ayligeze.
e`tle `m ny`ile azp`i rl npz yiy`ilpe dpkxi kli `gx l`gx dyaz, epnv` yiy xeg liyx`l and yny`il ldpkxi bm ayaz, nkl nwem kieo y`ipe pehl ykixez nny arc fd l` bfxe gknim:
c `qex ldy`il yem gtu lpkxi ayaz, e`tle arxa yaz, `m de` qnej lgykd kl kj rc y`io ydez lpkxi ldevi` dgtu ntzg aize yl diyx`l lxyez dxaim narec iem `qex ldy`ile, ntpi nx`iz drio, ydxe`d `z dpkxi iev` naiz diyx`l egtu iyx`l aice igyec `z diyx`l yde` yelg gtvie ayaz rl ici pkxi fd, yl` irld rl crze ydy`il le ede` nevi`e lvxj rvne.
e`tle arix y`io ad xyez dxaim `l` kxnliz, y`io `qex yl zexd `tle liyx`l ldevi` lzekd nxyez digic, `s rl ti ko kieo yncaxi qetxim `qex ldevi` `tle rl ici pkxi yl` lvxj nved kne yiza`x aqno y"f, `m ko igycede yde` reax rl caxi qetxim:
d `al arix dnrxaz ynzx lhlhl azekd nzx ldy`ile `tle ayaz `m dpkxi cx anwem dnrxa ynzx lhlhl ae. `e `tle cx anwem y`ipe nrxa, `l` arpio y`io lgey lnx`iz drio yl dxe`d `eze iev` naize yl iyx`l (kbeo yaize yl iyx`l xgew kl kj nnwem y`ipe nrxa, arpio ydxe`d `eze iev` naize yl iyx`l `ipe xe`d kyde` iev` lnwem y`ipe nrxa).
enkl nwem, `m icer le ydpkxi ielikpe diem geu lzgem `qex ldy`ile ayaz, lti ygtve yl iyx`l ydie axyeze aaio dynyez wpe `vle yaizd ayaizze, cdipe `ltim `nd lkl xeg el` iezx. e`s y`io `cm nfdx rl zgem klie kne y`ipe nved rl yaizz klie, nkl nwem kieo ywpe yaizd `vle e`io ldm `l` `ltim `nd `qex le lbxem ldm aicim yiea`e geu lzgem rl ici yneqxe aic pkxi. `al nzx ldx`ezm le elenx le yihlm nrvne, kieo y`ipe neqxm le aicim.
eiy nzixio `tle lnqex le aicim, kieo ydpkxi de` dnevi`o geu lzgem ncrze lvxj rvne, ediyx`l `ipe `l` bexm arln`. eko rwx.
eiy gelwio rl kl fd e`enxim, y`tle arix dnrxaz, e`tle dpkxi cx bm ko anwem dnrxa `qex ldy`ile ayaz, `e `tle arxa yaz kl y`ipe iev` ntzg aize narec iem, lti ydxe`d `eze iev` naiz iyx`l ayaz egtu iyx`l aice i`nx ynkx le gtu fd ayaz, `e dlede le lfno nxad (cdipe iezx nl' iem ydi` pwx`z dle`d), el` dzixe ayaz `l` y`ld yde` lfno nerh kne yiza`x aqno y"f, `e i`nx (dxe`d) ypzpe le lnykeo, e`qex lzo nykeo ayaz kne yiza`x ym, `e i`nx ypzpe le lzwpe elryez ae nl`kd, e`qex lzo ayaz yem cax lryez ae nl`kd `tle awalpez, e`tle wvu rne nrxa yaz.
elrpio dlkd, iy ldwl ay`ld arz dvxj kqax` dx`yepd. `al `m nkx le `tle arxa yaz, `e ydlede le lfno nxad iezx nylyim iem, `e ypzpe le lnykeo, `e ypzpe lryez ae nl`kd vxij yiv` ntzg aize narec iem `tle di` rix dnrxaz, lti yiy lgey yn` iecr ldxe`d `eze iev` naiz iyx`l ydiyx`l nkxe le, `e dlede, `e nykpe, `e pzpe le lryez ae nl`kd, kieo yko de` d`nz, eigycde yryd ko ayaz, nd y`io ko ay`ld kyiecr le d`nz `io k`o gyc kll `s `m icnd le ydy`ile ayaz, ydxi nzx ldy`il ayaz:
e ekl fd agtvim yl iyx`l, `al gtvim yl pkxi ydie ntwcim aic iyx`l ea` lhle ayaz ikel lzpe e`s rl ti yievi`pe lxyez dxaim, kne yiza`x aqno yk"d, rio ym zylem cipim `le:
f `qex ldy`il adnze lpkxi lryez ad nl`kd, ntpi ydpkxi reyd ad bm ayaz, e`cm nved rl yaizz adnze, yp`nx "lnro ipeg yexj egnxj".
e`s ldykixd le `qex no dzexd, `s rl ti ynykixd dxad inim wcm dyaz, e`tle `m nzpd rne yl` iryd ad klem ayaz edahig le `io fd neril, ki `io dpkxi p`no rl kj, nhrm yiza`x aqno y"d, rio ym:
g and caxim `nexim? kybes dadnd yl iyx`l, `al iyx`l yykx adnd npkxi ikel lgfex eldykixd `e ldy`ild lpkxi `gx, ckieo y`io bes dadnd yle `ipe nved rl yaizzd.
eiy ni y`eqx ldy`ild, lti yiy ldqztw yn` rl ici dykixez yykxd diyx`l, ypezo cnim ldpkxi arcd kci yid` xy`i lryez ad nl`kd, pwpd le rl ici kj dadnd linim `le yykxd le ndpkxi, ekygefx eny`ild lpkxi edpkxi reyd ad nl`kd ayaz reax diyx`l nyem yaizz adnze, nd y`io ko kygefx enykixd lpkxi nzx, nnd ptyj, y`m pwpd bes dadnd liyx`l pwpd bm ko lpkxi yykxd nnpe, e`io diyx`l nved rl yaizzd. ehea lgey lcaxie:
h nzx ldykix `e ldy`il adnze lpkxi eldzpez rne yigfixpd le wcm dyaz. e`m rax dpkxi rl zp`e erkad el` dgfixd wcm dyaz itwixpd diyx`l aipe laio rvne wcm dyaz, y`f `ipe nved rl yaizzd, kieo y`ipd yle, ykax dtwixd.
e`s rl ti yncaxi qetxim kl dtwx y`ipe atpi ylyd `ipe dtwx kll, ykyiy ylyd aec`i de` ntwix ala ylm, e`io k`o gyy drxnd, ydxi `gc ndylyd ikel lfkez nic adtwx dfd, edypim dpy`xim ikelim ldric le yfkd nddtwx, el` iekl dntwix lgfex ae eldevi`e nnpe, nkl nwem `s rl ti yntwix aipe laio rvne aec`i ntwix ala ylm, kci yipvl n`qex yl zexd.
enkl nwem, `io `cm `gx ikel lfkez ad `tle `m ntwixd atpi ylyd ky`x dtwx, ckieo y`ipd ntwixd `l` kci ldtwir nrlie `qex yaz alac, `m ko no dqzm `ipe ntwixd `l` liem dyaz alac, ayrd ydpkxi reyd ad nl`kd, ydtwx liem `gc `e `tle lyrd `gz dxi de` dtwx bnex l`eze iem e`ezd yrd, kne yiza`x agyo nyth qno xr"b. eanev`i yaz nic di` gefxz ldiez yle, e`io yem `cm ikel lfkez ad.
e`s ayaz `ipd dtwx `l` ayrd yreyd ad nl`kd, ydxi l` dtwixd `l` kci ldpvl n`qex ryiz dnl`kd ydpkxi reyd ad ayaz, e`m ko ayrd y`ipe reyd ad klem di` gefxz ldiez yle, e`io yem `cm ikel lfkez ad.
(`l` ayrd ydpkxi reyd ad, e`f l` ipigpe dpkxi. e`s `m ipigpe dpkxi, nkl nwem `ezd xbr yfekd ad di` ahld nnl`kz dpkxi, egefxz di` ldiez yl iyx`l):
i e`m de` xevd ikel ldwpez bes dadnd lpkxi fd liem dyaz wcm dyaz, ede` yi`nx le atpie adnzi wpeid lj, y`f nzkeo dpkxi lwpezd, edi` pwpiz le a`nixd fe kieo ydi` axyeze, `al `m `enx ko yl` atpie l` wp`d dpkxi kll:
i` ekl fd acirac, ykax dykixd `e dy`ild lpkxi adzx, ydzpd rne yigfixpd le wcm dyaz, `al lkzgld `qex ldykixd `e ldy`ild qzm rl qnj ykyibir dyaz itwixpd `e iwpd `ezd ldpkxi, lti yntxqm lxaim ydi` adnz iyx`l, eddtwx eddwp`d `ipo ntxqnim kll, eiy k`o gyy nx`iz drio.
eiy nzixio ldykix `e ldy`il lkzgld rl qnj ykyibir dyaz itwixpd `e iwpd `ezd ldpkxi atpi ylyd iyx`lim, yrl ici dylyd iyx`lim iztxqm dcax lkl ni yiecr ydi` adnz iyx`l.
eiy lqnej rl caxidm ayrz dcgw, kbeo ni yiy le ycez e`i `tyx le lzpo lpkxi a`xiqez `l` `m ko iykix le bm yexim lgxey adm, e`i `tyx le lnpre yl` igxey adm ayaz, ebm `i `tyx le ldhil rlie kl `gxiez dyexim `s lrpio iwx efel enizd a`pq rl cxj yiza`x `fi iy ldzix le yitwixm atpi b'. ehea ldexez le yitwixm atpi cipi drix, edm itxye le rpio ddtwx, yitwixm ala nl`, el` izar no dpkxi `tle `m rl ici tyireze i`xr adm dtqc ayaz, edm itxqne ddtwx lkl, yl` idid gyy nx`iz drio.
eko iy ldzix lvxj nved, kbeo lyleg `zxebim rl adnze rl ici pkxi, rl cxj yiza`x aqno zxp"d, `m ntwix adnze atpi ylyd. e`m `i `tyx le ikel ldtwix `tle aipe laio rvne, ylcax nved `io lgey lnx`iz drio.
`al yl` lvxj nved eyl` ayrz dcgw `io ldzix lkzgld, `tle xevd ltxqm lxaim yntwixd, `e ynwpd bes dadnd ldpkxi liem dyaz, lti y`tyx yinv`e dxad yiecrim ndykixez edy`ld ydo lkl inez dyaer, e`ipo iecrim nddtwxd eddwp`d ydo lyaz alac, eix`d ldm ybm ayaz di` ykexd ey`eld alac ldpkxi ebes dadnd yl iyx`l kne akl inez dyaer.
`al `m bm ainez dgl bes dadnd wpei ldpkxi, `s rl ti yl` dwpd le wpio bnex yid` xyez aice lnkxd elzo ldiyx`l cnid, `l` l` dwpd `ezd le xw lrpio iwx efel e`gxiez nizd, cdipe yym `ezd acnim ldpkxi ayrd ydykixd `e dy`ild le, e`m zziwx aqes nyj fno ykixeze `e y`ilze kyigfixpd ldiyx`l idid drcs ldpkxi, e`m zefl izgia lylm le drcs naize `s rl ti yde` `peq afel fd, eko `m znez `tle a`pq izgia lylm, epnv` xeg adnd fe egqxepd dkl lpkxi k`le dizd adnze nny, ltikj `io diyx`l nved rl yaizzd, y`s ybes dadnd nyrac le yl` iekl dpkxi lnkxd yl` ncrze, nkl nwem kl fno ydi` ngqxz beaip`, yrcio l` bad `ezd naiz dpkxi laize dxi di` kadnz dpkxi, kieo y`io ldiyx`l rlid `l` yraec arln`, ekl gqxepd exegd ldpkxi.
e`io lgey lnx`iz drio, kieo y`ipd yl dpkxi ayaz lac `l` akl fno nyj ykixeze `e y`ileze `tle ainez dgl, `m ko dxi fd cend lnekx adnze lpkxi edpkxi reyd ad nl`kd ayaz, y`io ym gyy nx`iz drio, lti yiy txqem lcax.
enkl nwem, kieo yl` nkxd le nny iy le ltxqm lxaim yryd cxj dzx, ykl nd y`tyx le lryez ldevi` `z rvne nici gyc iy le lryez:
ia eko ikel ldykixd `e ldy`ild lpkxi rl ici yifdix `eze yl` iryd ad ayaz, ea`m yiraex rl zp`e eiryd `fi di` wpeid le liem dyaz eizgia a`pqio yi`xre ld ayaz, eikzea ko arxk`ezidm, ypnv` kya` dpkxi lryez ad ayaz `ipd adnz iyx`l kll, ydxi wp`d dpkxi ldzgia a`pqid. e`s y`ipd wpeid le `l` ayaz alac `io lgey lnx`iz drio, kieo ykza ko arxk`ezidm iy lcax wel etxqem:
ib iyx`l epkxi ydm yztim aadnd lhgeo axgim ekiev` iy dzx yiryd ad dpkxi ayaz rl ici yizpd rm dpkxi azgld ayrd ywp`ed yihel dpkxi kl ykx dyaz alace ediyx`l ihel kpbc fd kl ykx iem `gc agl alace, ykynzpd rne ko azglz dyztez dxi fd knwpd le alace kl bes dadnd lyazez eliyx`l alace aiem `gx, e`io ldiyx`l glw ad ayazez, e`ipe nved rl yaizzd. e`m `gx kj pzxvd dpkxi n`lie lglew rne kl dykx ayed dxi fd nzx, kne ypza`x aqno xn"d.
e`tle `m `gxiez dadnd de` rl ypidm ayed kl inez dyaer `tle ayaz `s rl ti ko `io diyx`l nved rl yaizzd ngnz y`gxiezd bm rlie ayaz, kieo ydzpd rne yihel kl ykx dyaz lrvne dxi di` wpeid le alace lyaz, e`io liyx`l glw ad kll, end y`gxiezd bm rl diyx`l fde zp`i `gx ydxeig diyx`l ldpkxi nyle ewal bm rlie `gxiez dyaz, y`f di` yl dpkxi, edpkxi dxeig nyle ldiyx`l, ewal bm rlie `gxiez iem `gc agl, y`f di` yl diyx`l:
ic e`m l` dzpd rne ko azglz dyztez l` izpd rne `gx kj, y`s `m rkye `io k`o `qex nyem yaizz adnze, ydxi rkye `io dpkxi pnpr nlryez ad nl`kd arl kxge yl diyx`l n`gx ykax pyzzs eiy le glw ad, nkl nwem iy `qex and ypehl xeg iem `gc agl kpbc iem dyaz, ydxi pehl ykx yaz yl` adalrd kne ypza`x aqno xn"d, eakbeo fd yl` dzpe nzgld iezx iy dzx kyl` i`nx le kll "hl `zd ayaz e`pi agl", `l` iglew rne kl dxeg yl kl inez dyaer ayed, y`f de` pehl ykx yaz adalrd.
`l` ybm fd `io ldzix `l` anwem dtqc bcel, `m bm dpkxi arvne vxij lryez nl`kd ayaz rm dadnd ediyx`l iryd kpbce agl, kne ypza`x ym:
he ebm anwem dtqc bcel, `e `tle `ipe xevd lhel kll agl kpbc dyaz, `s y`io `qex nyem ykx yaz, el` nyem yaizz adnze, n`gx ydpkxi `ipe pnpr nlryez ad nl`kd ayaz arl kxge yl diyx`l, nkl nwem iy `qex lntxr and ypyzzs rm dpkxi aadnd ydpkxi iryd ad nl`kd ayaz arl kxge. eiy zweo lfd rl ici yizpd rne y`m iryd ad nl`kd ayaz `fi di` wpeid le liem dyaz, eizgia a`pqio yi`xre ayaz, eikzea ko, kne ypza`x lnrld, `e rl ici yiwpd le bm glwe lrpio iwx efel enizd a`pq, kne ypza`x lnrld.
`e `tle inkex le glwe ankixd bnexd, e`s rl ti ko l` iekl dpkxi lnkxd yl` ncrze, kbeo yifwes rlie dcnim anled yitxrm le kyizarpe, eigfex dpkxi eiryd le adnd fe `teziwi lgeae, cdipe ykl fno yl` itxr le geae anrez l` iekl lqlwe acax `gx ki `m aadnd fe, eltikj kl fno yl` pzo le dnrez `ipe ikel lnkxd yl` ncrze, e`s rl ti ko `ipe reax rlid nyem yaizz adnze, kieo yrcio l` bad nnpe adnd fe ltxreo (geae), e`io le rlid `l` yraec arln`.
e`m de` xevd, ikel lwg dadnd laize lnykeo l`gx yfws rlie dcnim anled, ei`nx le "`m l` ztxrpi glwi anrez ky`zarj zd` adnd fe wpeid li `f ldtxr nnpd geai", eigfex eizo le dadnd lraec ad. eltikj, kl fno yl` pzo le dnrez `ipe ikel lnkxd yl` ncrze, e`s rl ti ko `ipe reax rlid nyem yaizz adnze kl fno yl` zare el` pwpiz le ltxreo, ealac yl` i`nx le "nrkye zd` wpeid li `m l` ztxrpi glwi anrez ky`zarj", lti ykyizarpe glwe ayrz glwd, `e kyi`xr ad dtqc, `e kyixvd dpkxi lnkxd el` itxr le anrez pnv` ylntxr dizd wpeid liyx`l, erax rlid nyem yaizz adnze:
hf eaio yry`d `teziwi eaio yl` ry`d, eaio yphld lnykeo eaio yl` phld, `l` nkxd le ankixd bnexd yid` xyez aice lnkxd yl` ncrze, kieo ykl fno yl` nkxd dm yztim ad eiy gyy nx`iz rio, ltikj iy le ltxqm lxaim yryd cxj dzx:
if dzx fd yl ryiz `teziwi, `e yihld lnykeo, neril `s kykl dadnd di` yl iyx`l enykixd `e ny`ild lpkxi, xw yitxqm yryd cxj dzx:
ig and caxim `nexim? kynykixd `e ny`ild le lryez nl`kz rvne, `al lryez nl`kz iyx`l ayaz `io dzx kll `tle `m nkxd le ankixd bnexd, ynkl nwem dpkxi reyd nl`kd ayaz ayail diyx`l `m l` wvu le ykx rl fd. eko `m de` ykixe lypd lkl dnl`kez yivhxj, ycipe k`le l` wvu, kne ypza`x aqno xn"b exn"c.
`al `m `ipe ykex le `l` lnl`kd fe alac, lryezd le akl rz yivhxj ld azej nyj fno ykixeze, kbeo ni yiy le qeqim erbld eykx le pkxi lypd yiqr rm qeqim erbld yle akl rz yivhxj ldelij adm qgexd azej ypd fe, edpkxi peqr bm ayaz nrvne al` `nixz diyx`l `ipe vxij lenx le yl` iqr ayaz `m peqr naiz diyx`l narec iem, nhrm ypza`x aqno xn"c. xw yiwpd le dqeqim a`gc ndcxkim ypza`xe, eitxqm yryd cxj dzx. ede` yidie wpeiim le bm ainez dgl azej nyj fno pqirze, `al `m `ipe nwpd le `l` lyaz alac `qex ntpi nx`iz drio, kne ypza`x lnrld. eko `m de` rvne peqr bm ko rm dqeqim kl inez dgl enfepezidm rlie dxi dm pwx`im rl yne `s rl ti ynkxm ldpkxi ankixd bnexd `s linez dgl, kieo ydpkxi `ipe `l` ykixe, eltikj vxij de` lngez aice yl` iqr ayaz ntpi nx`iz drio:
ih kym y`cm nved rl yaizz adnze ayaz kj de` nved rl yaizzd aiem hea. ltikj, kl txhi ddlkez ypza`xe lrpio y`ld eykixez adnze lpkxi eyztez rne bai yaz, do pedbim bm ko bai iem hea, y`io aio iem hea lyaz `l` nl`kez ydzxe abll `kl pty, yp`nx "kl nl`kd l` iryd adm, `j `yx i`kl lkl pty ebe'".
eiy `enxim yaiem hea `io `cm nved no dzexd rl yaizz adnze, lti yl` pvheipe aiem hea `l` yl` pryd nl`kd, end yadnzpe reyd `io fe pwx`z nl`kd `vlpe `l` `vl dadnd, e`s ayaz l` lncpe `qex fd nnd yp`nx "l` zryd kl nl`kd", y`io fe nl`kd kll `vlpe, `l` nved `gxz di`, yp`nx "lnro ipeg yexj egnxj", e`ipd pedbz aiem hea kll. ede` dcio lyaizz race y`ipd pedbz aiem hea lti caxidm, lti y`ipd akll nl`kd `l` nved `gxz di`, yp`nx "lnro ipeg racj e`nzj knej".
elrpio dlkd, iy ldgnix ayl zexd kqax` dx`yepd (rio qno zv"d):
` nzx lyleg `bxz `e y`x gtvim eklim aic pkxi `tle arxa yaz qnej lgykd, kl yiev` ntzg aize yl iyx`l narec iem, ede` ywvu le cnim aykx delkze, y`f `ipe reyd ayail diyx`l `l` ayail rvne lwal dykx ywvu le, e`ipe px`d kylege yl iyx`l.
ealac yl` i`nx le yilj bm ayaz, y`nixd lpkxi yaez `s y`enx le wcm dyaz. eko l` i`nx le x`d yzd` ym a`gc ayaz `e aypi ekiev` afd `m icer le y`i `tyx le ldiez `f ym `m l` yilj bm ayaz, ydxi fd k`enx le lj ayaz:
a e`m l` wvu le ykx ddlikd dxi dpkxi hexg ayail iyx`l, ltikj `qex lylge `tle aiem x`yeo, `l` `m ko iy ydez yiekl ldbir wcm dyaz laiz dx`yeo dqnej lgend yarix ypyzlg lym, y`f `s `m `gx cxke edelj bm ayaz `io akj klem, ydlikd fe `ipd ngnz diyx`l `l` ngnz rvne. e`s y`tyx yivhxj lilj ayaz naiz dx`yeo dqnej lgend ya`ezd drix rc aiz yl ni yvxij lzo d`bxz lice, nkl nwem kieo y`io k`o `qex `l` ncaxi qetxim zelio ldwl lenx y`eze `cm yvxij lzo d`bxz lice de` cx aaiz dqnej lgend:
b and caxim `nexim? kynylg d`bxz l`cm waer yiy a`ezd rix yde` nwau kl d`bxez dylegez lym epehlo eyelgo rl ici ylege kl `bxz lni ypkzad `lie, efde dpwx` "ai c`x", ykl kza `lie ieal, ekyde` waer arix `fi nzx lyleg `lie `bxz `tle arxa yaz rl ici pkxi yl` wvu le ykx, kl yiy ydez ldbir `lie narec iem.
`al `m `io ai c`x waer a`ezd drix yyelg lym, evxij dpkxi arvne ldbir d`bxz lic ni ypkzad `lie `qex lylge `tle aiem x`yeo, `s rl ti yiy ydez ldbir l`ezd drix dxad wcm dyaz, nkl nwem iy lgey yn` l` inv` `eze `cm aaize eivhxj lilj `gxie, eyn` ivhxj lilj `gxie bm ayaz.
enkl nwem, `m de` cxj wxea, kbeo ndlj iem `gc, enylge aiem a' `e b' iy ldzix, y`s `m l` inv` d`iy aaize iy le ydez dxad llkz wcm dyaz:
c ekl fd kyl` wvu, `al `m wvu nzx lylge `tle lrix y`io ym ai c`x, e`tle di` cxj xgewd n`c, e`tle iev` naize rxa yaz rm gykd:
d eiy `enxim y`tle l` wvu `io `qex lylge `l` arxa yaz, ckieo ynylge qnej lyaz dxi px`d k`le `enx le lilj ayaz, ltikj vxij yid` ydez aiem yiekl ldbir narec iem laiz dqnej lgend ya`ezd drix `m waer ym ai c`x. e`m l` waer ym ai c`x `qex lylge arxa yaz `l` `m ko wvu. `al kynylge ac' ed', `e wcm lko, kieo yde` ntlb ltpi dyaz `io px`d k`enx le lilj ayaz, eltikj `s rl ti yl` wvu nzx lylge `tle lcxj xgewd n`c, `s rl ti y`io ai c`x waer a`ezd drix. eiy lqnej rl caxidm `m vxikim lkj:
e `io glew aio ywaer ai c`x a`ezd drix ly`ipe waer `l` a`bxz ydi` kza ic iyx`l, ypkx lkl ydi` yl iyx`l, ekydpkxi nelikd ayaz `gx d`iy ypylgd `lie iy wvz nx`iz drio, yi`nxe yayaz pzpd le diyx`l ldelikd, e`s rl ti ko kynylge ntlb ltpi dyaz l` dgnixe kl kj lgey lnx`iz drio kfd lti qax` d`gxepd ypza`x, ekywvu l` dgnixe lcaxi dkl.
`al `m di` kza ic pkxi, ede` dcio y`x gtvim y`ipm pkxim lkl ydm yl iyx`l nzx lylgm `tle arxa yaz lcaxi dkl, kl yiy ydez aiem yiekl ldbir narec iem laiz dqnej lgend ya`ezd drix yyelgm lym, y`s `m l` inv` d`iy aaize eivhxj lilj `gxie ayaz `io akj klem, kieo yayrd ydiyx`l nylge `io dcax icer le yl` inv` aaize, edxi nylge ayligez y`tyx lbnxd narec iem, ekydelj `gx kj bm ayaz `ipe px`d kylege yl iyx`l, kieo yayrd yylge l` did icer yivhxj lilj ayaz:
f `m ykxe linim cax wvea lkl iem adlikze egfixze, `l` y`ipe nwtic rne nzi ilj `qex lykxe elzo d`bxz lice arxa yaz, cyn` iv` ayaz eid` px`d k`le vede lilj ayaz, kieo yykxe linim eykxe qnej lyaz. `al ac' ed' nzx lykxe linim elzo le `f d`bxz, de`il e`ipe nwtic rne a`ifd iem ilj kyilj ayaz `ipe px`d kylege. e`s yykxe linim, `ipe cend lykix iem, de`il ewal rlie kl nl`kz delkz d`bxz dxi fd cend lwalo (rio qno xn"b exn"c):
g `m `nx ldpkxi yizo le ykxe, `s rl ti yl` txy knd izo le dxi fd k`le wvu ewva le, ycrz dpkxi qnekd yaec`i izo le ykxe kti nd yiztyx rne `gx kj, eayail heaz rvne de` hexg. `al `m l` `nx le atxey yizo le ykxe, `l` ydpkxi nrvne iecr yiylm le `io fd klem, y`io crz dpkxi qnekd aec`i rl dykx dde`, yiy qtw alae yn` l` izo le, eayail diyx`l de` hexg:
h and caxim `nexim? kyde` nvtd ennzio lzylem ykx e`io crze qnekd rlie aec`i, `al `m `ipe nvtd kll lzylem ykx `l` reyd agpm no dqzm reyd ko lylm bnel liyx`l rl dhead ywal nnpe kax, edxi fd kreyd ayail ykx.
eiy gelwio rl fd, `m l` ydpkxi n`lie nzgil lenx ldiyx`l yilj le agpm, y`f aec`i crze ayail heaz dp`d ywal nnpe kax. ehea ldgnix kcaxidm:
i `al lyleg `bxz agpm arxa yaz aic race dykex le lypd `e lyzim lkl dnl`kez yivhxj azej nyj fno ykixeze lcaxi dkl `qex, kne ypza`x aqno xn"c, ydrwx kd`eqxio afd, rio ym dhrm.
enkl nwem, ac' ed' iy ldzix lyleg `tle yl` arz dvxj, kieo yiy nzixim aykix ypd yreyd nl`kd ayail iyx`l kne ypza`x aqno xn"c, e`s rl ti y`io caxidm rwx, nkl nwem iy lvxs caxidm lcaxi d`enxim yac' ed' nzx lyleg `bxz akl rpio `s rl ti yl` wvu kll, elqnej rl fd ldwl lbnxi `s yl` arz dvxj:
i` `al `m `io dpkxi ykex le lkl dnl`kez yivhxj, `l` lyleg aice `bxez alac akl rz yivhxj lyleg azej nyj dfno ykixeze nzx lyleg aice `tle arxa yaz, rl cxj ypza`x aqno xn"c, rio ym dhrm:
ia kl nwem y`qex lyleg ntpi yl` wvu, `s `m dpkxi delj nrvne l`ezd drix yiy le cxj lym iy ldgnix yl` lyleg aice kyl` wvu, y`s y`ipe hexg klem adlikd ayail iyx`l, nkl nwem nd yde` nevi` d`bxz nxyez lxyez enraixd c' `nez axyez dxaim, `e `tle akxnliz, de` reyd nl`kez `le ayail iyx`l kyl` wvu.
enkl nwem, `m iy ydez ldbir lym wcm dyaz nzx lyleg aice `s rl ti y`io ai c`x waer ym, lti y`s `m l` inv` d`iy aaize l` ilj `gxie kll, kieo y`io le cxj lym, ede` `ipe pey` `bxz fe al` wvivd `l` ngnz yiy le cxj lym:
` `io ntlibim aqtipd ainim dnlegim tgez nb' inim nrz lrz wcm dyaz, cdipe niem c' e`ilj, eiem c' akll d`qex, lti ykl dntlibim ainim dnlegim iy ldm akl b' inim dx`yepim vrx ealael eypei eqz, ebetm nyzax nprper dqtipd, e`io xegm gefxz rc l`gx ylyd inim nrz lrz, e`m itlib tgez nb' inim wcm dyaz l` idid le rpb ayaz.
and caxim `nexim? kyntlib lcax dxyez, `al lcax nved nzx ldtlib `tle arxa yaz, `s rl ti yl` idid le rpb ayaz, lti ydreqw anved thex nnved `gxz.
enkl nwem, lkzgld itqew rm dpkxi dnelij dqtipd yiyaez el` ielikpd ayaz, e`m `gx kj `ipe yeaz `io akj klem.
e`m `i `tyx le ltqew rne, ybm rkye `enx yl` iyaez ayaz iy `enxim y`qex le ldtlib rc l`gx dyaz.
(enkl nwem, `m iy gyy yzzahl dnved ydelj `lid ngnz `gex cxke iy ldwl. eko `m `i `tyx awl lnve` qtipd l`gx dyaz ldtlib ad iy ldwl ayrz dcgw):
a e`m de` cxj nerh, kbeo nvx lviceo, y`io ym `l` ndlj iem `gc kydxeg hea nzx ldtlib `tle lcax dxyez arxa yaz aawx, lti y`tyx yidid xeg hea eibire lym wcm dlild.
eanwem ypdbe yl` ldtlib arxa yaz kll `tle cxj nerh `qex ldm lypez ndnpdb, rl cxj yiza`x aqno zq"g eaiexd crd qno xi"c:
b ekl fd ainim, `al apdxez kieo y`io yem vrx ldntlibio ado nzx ldtlib adm `tle arxa yaz akl rpio `m dqtipd delkz ayail pkxim.
e`s rl ti ydelj ayaz knd txq`ez `io afd nyem `qex zgenio `tle ld`enxim czgem i"a nil de` no dzexd, yp`nx "`l iv` `iy nnwne", cdipe nngpd iyx`l ydizd i"a nil, nkl nwem kyndlj rl tpi dnim `io afd `qex no dzexd, kieo y`ipe cend lngpd iyx`l ydizd aiayd.
e`s rl ti yrl kl tpim iy `qex zgenio anim ncaxi qetxim, nkl nwem `m dqtipd ndlkz lnrld ni' htgim nwxwr dpdx `io afd `qex `tle ncaxi qetxim, lti yiy qtw `m iy `qex zgenio lnrld ni' htgim `tle ai"a nil aiayd, kne yiza`x aqno z"c, ekieo yrl tpi dnim `io `qex zgenio `tle i"a nil `l` ncaxi qetxim lcaxi dkl, `m ko dxi fd qtw caxi qetxim, ydelkio ae ldwl akl nwem.
`al `m dqtipd ndlkz lnhd ni' htgim, cdipe y`io i' htgim nim nzgz yeli dqtipd rc wxwriz dpdx `qex lilj ad ayaz geu lzgem, `tle pkpq lqtipd ylyd inim wcm dyaz, cdipe nlil xairi ayaz e`ilj, e`tle `m dqtipd nywrz dxad anim arpio y`vl ctpid iy anim rnw i' htgim ezgz yelid `io ym i' htgim dxi fd `qex, `tle `m de` ieya lnrld arpio ynnwem iyiaze iy iezx ni' htgim.
eiy nzixio kyde` ieya lnrld ni' htgim e`io xblie zleiez lzej nhd ni' htgim, `m dqtipd ndlkz lnrld nb' htgim, e`io `qex `l` kyieya rl yeli dqtipd e`io nrl yelid rc dwxwr i' htgim, `e yieya rl cax `gx e`io nrl `eze cax rc dwxwr i' htgim. eiy lqnej rl caxidm kyvxij lkj:
c e`m de` nqtw `m di` ndlkz lnrld ni' htgim `e lnhd ni' htgim dxi fd nzx, ykl yiy qtw acaxi qetxim delkio ldwl, e`io vxij ldgnix `l` kyicer aaxex yiy `qex ncaxi qetxim:
d e`m pkpq lqtipd wcm b' inim ltpi dyaz, cdipe ayliyi ayaz `e wcm lko nzx lilj ad ayaz geu lzgem, `s `m icer le yndlkz lnhd ni' htgim, `e `tle lnhd nb' htgim, ckieo y`qex zgenio `ipe `l` ncaxidm l` xve ldgnix kl kj l`qex kypkpq lqtipd wcm b' inim, kieo yde` `ipe reyd klem, edqtipd di` ynelikd `eze ngeu lzgem.
e`tle `m de` arpio y`tyx yivhxj diyx`l lgll yaz adelkz dqtipd, `tle anl`kd d`qexd no dzexd, ntpi tweg pty `s rl ti ko nzx le lkpq azekd wcm b' inim, ydxi rkye de` pkpq adzx, ekyibir dyaz eivhxj lryez nl`kd ntpi tweg pty nzx de`, e`io k`o glel.
`al zej b' inim wcm yaz `qex lkpq lzekd, `tle `m di` ndlkz lnrld ni' htgim `m iecr yivhxj lgll yaz ntpi tweg pty, `tle acax y`ipe `qex `l` ncaxi qetxim, lti ypx`d kpkpq akepd lnwem qkpd kci yigll yaz `gx kj.
end y`io geyyim lkj wcm b' inim, de`, lti yb' inim dx`yepim yayaer do pwx`im inim y`gx dyaz drax, e`ipm nzigqim lyaz da`d, ltikj `ipe ngia lfdx adm yl` lryez adm cax yiecr yivhxj `gx kj lgll yaz da`d, ykyibir yaz eivhxj lglle ntpi tweg pty nzx de`, e`io k`o glel. nd y`io ko ab' inim d`gxepim yayaer ypwx`im inim yltpi dyaz enzigqim lyaz da`d ngia de` ncaxi qetxim ldfdx adm yl` lryez adm cax yiecr yivhxj `gx kj lgll dyaz, yl` id` px`d k`le nzkeo aryize kci lgll dyaz `gx kj:
e e`tle `m icer le yl` ivhxj lgll dyaz kll, ydpkxim reyim dkl, nkl nwem `m rwx ddlikd yl dqtipd de` ayail iyx`l, kbeo yxad iyx`l `qex lkpq azekd azej b' inim yltpi dyaz, `tle `m di` ndlkz lnrld ni' htgim, lti ynd ydpkxim reqwim adelkz dqtipd ayaz iy afd `qex bnex (`s rl ti ydm reqwim nrvnm al` `nixz iyx`l, edm nzkepim lheazm lwal dykx ywvve ldm arc yielike `ezm lngef gtvm, edxi dm walpim lkj, enzx ldpig lwalo yiryd nl`kze ayaz, nkl nwem k`o) ydiyx`l pdpd ayaz rvnd nbes dnl`kd yreyd dpkxi ayaile ayaz (dxi kl dnl`kd pwx`z rl ym diyx`l, y`s rl ti ydpkxi nzkeo kci yibir le head nfd, nkl nwem kieo yrkye ayrz ryiz dnl`kd iy liyx`l dp`d nnpd dxi di` pryiz ayaile iezx nayail dpkxi, ydpkxi bm ko nzkeo ayail diyx`l, `l` yreyd ko arc dykx yizo le, e`ipe cend lwalo dnzwo klim liyx`l ayaz, y`io diyx`l pdpd ayaz rvnd nbes nl`kd fe, `l` l`gx dyaz, kyibnxm eiyzny adm).
eltikj, `io dzx lrelm lilj ayaz aqtipd dndlkz ayail iyx`l, `l` yntpi dqkpd nzx de` kieo ykax pkpqe lzekd, e`m l` ilke ayaz iqzkpe, `m ko `io lkpq lzekd `l` wcm b' inim yltpi dyaz, nhrm ypza`x:
f ekl fd kydelj lcax dxyez, `al lcax nved nzx ldtlib `tle arxa yaz, `tle aqtipd dndlkz lnhd ni' htgim, `tle de` arpio ykyibir wxea lrix `tyx yivhxj lilj geu lzgem ntpi dqkpd, e`tle dqtipd delkz ayail iyx`l, e`tle ivhxj lryez nl`kez bnexez d`qexez no dzexd, ckieo yrkye ntlib adzx l` bfxe gknim kydelj lcax nved, `s yivhxj `gx kj lgll yaz ntpi tweg pty.
enkl nwem, lkzgld itqew rm dpkxi yiyaez, el` ilj ayaz kyl` idid `f gyy qkpd acax, e`m `gx kj l` iyaez eilj `s y`io gyy qkpd acax `io akj klem:
g `al lgll yaz lvxj nved, `tle acax y`io ae `l` `qex yaez ncaxi qetxim l` dzixe, `l` `m ko de` yaez cyaez, kne yiza`x aqno y"f. ltikj, `m `io ym gyy qkpd kyiv` ndqtipd el` ilj rndm geu lzgem ayaz `qex le ldtlib ad lilj rndm bm ayaz `m di` ndlkz lnhd ni' htgim, `s rl ti ydelj lcax nved, `l` `m ko pkpq lzekd wcm b' inim yltpi dyaz:
h eko `qex le lkpq aqtipd ayaz rvnd `s rl ti ydelj lcax nved, `tle ndlkz lnrld ni' htgim, e`tle lilj lzej dzgem, e`tle di` ndlkz ayail pkxim, lti y`qxe lkpq kll aqtipd ayaz, `tle `ipd ndlkz kll `l` vtd rl tpi dnim, kne yiza`x aqno yl"h, lti ypx`d k`le de` rvne vs eyh rl tpi dnim, e`qex lyeh ayaz nyem bfxd yn` iryd gaiz yl yihio ynlncio `z rvno lyeh anim rl gaiz.
`al kypkpq lqtipd nrxa yaz, `s rl ti ydelkz bm ayaz epx`d kyh l` bfxe gknim, kieo yde` `ipe reyd klem ayaz, yn`lie de` yh rl ici kpiqze lzekd nrxa yaz, ydi` yrz dzx `tle lryez gaiz yl yihio, eltikj `tle `m di` ntlbz ndiayd ayaz rvne `io akj klem, kieo ypkpq lzekd nrxa yaz.

eiy nzixio lkpq azekd eldtlib ayaz `m wpd ad yaizd nrxa yaz, cdipe ydid azekd nzglz aio dynyez rc ygykd, ckieo yazglz kpiqz dyaz dizd yaizze azekd pryiz di` kaize, e`s yiv` nnpd `gx kj eydd dxad aiayd, e`tle lo ym l` dtqic afd yaizze yaqtipd, xw yifdx lgfex l`ezd qtipd ywpd ad yaizd el` ikpq lqtipd `gxz.
eko pztyh dnpdb awvz nwenez, e`io lngez aicm, `s ydrwx kqax` dx`yepd, kieo yiy ldm rl ni yiqnke.
enkl nwem, l`gx ydtlibd geu lzgem `qexim lv`z liayd, `tle pkpqd lzej rix dnwtz gend lcixd, kne yiza`x aqno z"d.
eiy pedbio rec lqcx ylgo aqtipd eldcliw ym pxez elryez wcey, kci yiztxqm lkl ywpe ad yaizd, el` igyce `ezm kyitlibe ad lngx aiem.
enkl nwem, vxikim ldfdx yiyae ym aqtipd kl aio dynyez rc yzgyj, el` iv`e nnpd kll a`nvr aio dynyez, yakl xbr exbr yaaio dynyez iy qtw yn` de` zglz dlild, eaxbr yl zglz dlild vxij ldiez aqtipd, kne ypza`x:
i e`tle `m gl iem hea arxa yaz ikel lwpez ae yaizd, e`io afd nyem dkpd. e`s `m wpd yaizd arxa iem hea `ipd nerlz lyaz yl`gxie. eko `m wpd yaizd arxa yaz `ipd nerlz liem hea y`gx dyaz, evxij lgfex elwpez yaizd aaio dynyez yl nev`i yaz liem hea. eko dcio aa' inim heaim yl bliez. `al aa' inim heaim yl x`y dypd ci ayaizd ywpd arxa iem hea dx`yeo `s liem hea dypi, kne yiza`x kl fd aqno zh"f:
i` ekl fd kyntlib apdx edqtipd delkz ayail pkxim endlkz lnrld ni' htgim.
e`s `m nelikim `ezd rl ici adnez dndlkim aytz dpdx `io akj klem, e`ipe cend lwxeo ynelikim `eze adnez, y`qex ldlj ae `tle azej dzgem, bfxd yn` igzej fnexd ldpdib ad dadnez, kne yiza`x aqno y"d, lti ydieya awxeo wxea de` `vl dadnez, ecxj de` yltrnim de` npdib dadnez, `al dieya aqtipd xgew de` nadnez dndlkez aytz dpdx enelikim `z dqtipd rl ici galim `xkim, e`io cxke lrelm ldpdib `ezo:
ia eanwem ypdbe ldtlib `s ainim dnlegim (nrxa yaz, `e `tle ayaz rl ici wpiz yaizd nrxa yaz), `m `ipm delkim lhiel `l` lqgexd, `e lx`ez tpi gaxidm `io lngez aicm, lti yiy ni y`enx ykl nd yd`cm delj lqgexd, `tle iy le nfepez edelj lqgexd ldxegd, `e ydelj lx`ez tpi gaxe gyea dkl cax nved lrpio fd, ynzx le ldtlib azej b' inim ltpi dyaz `s rl ti yizahl nrpb yaz, ebm `s y`tyx yivhxj lryez nl`kd bnexd arvne ntpi tweg pty, e`ipe gyea cax dxyez `l` ni ydelj lhil alac:

` `qex l`cm yidlj arxa yaz iezx nb' txq`ez nzglz diem, kci yibir lnwem yaizze arec diem bcel, eiekl ldkio ym vxki yaz. e`tle `m de` arpio y`m ilj iezx ibir laize, eapi aize `tyx yyne `l lam yn` ia` diem edkipe bm ayaile `s rl ti ko `qex, yn` l` yne `l lam kll nai`ze el` dkipe le klem.

f enkl nwem, nved ldzgil dqrcd lkzgld wcm yrd ryixiz, ydxi nyrd ryixiz e`ilj nved ldnpr nlwaer `tle qrcd whpd yxbil ad agl `m di` qrcz dxyez, kne yiza`x, `m ko bm aqrcz nved, kieo y`tyx ldwcind wcm yrd ryixiz iy le ldwcind lkzgld.
ehea yl` l`kel aqrcd fe `l` npio nvnvm, lac no dyikim lqrcd, kbeo dwxeaim edyeyaipim aqrcz pye`io, edwxeaim earli daxiz, cdipe dnedl edqpcw aqrcz nild:
g qrcz tcieo dao afnpe, cdipe aiem l"` llcze cipd kqrcz nild. `al `m `xr `ifd `pq yl` tc`e aiem l"` `io ltceze arxa yaz elryez `f qrcd yl nyzd, ckieo ykax pcgiz dnved nfnpd icgpd bm ko nrxa yaz, ntpi kaec dyaz (`l` itcpe al` qrcd yl nyzd).

(`al apye`io pnykz nvez dqrcd f' inim `gx dgtd, kne yiza`x aqno zx"n):

(enkl nwem, `io lngez aic dnwlio, kieo yno dcio `io giea bnex l`kel qrcz yaz lz`aeo, kne ypza`x):

e`s rl ti ykl dzrpiez `le yarxa yaz `ipm gead kll `io vxij lcgeze ntpi kaec dyaz, lti y`qex fd yl` ikpq lyaz kyde` nrpd `qex wl de`, el` gyye le `l` yl` lwaer ae dzrpiz lkzgld ky`tyx lware aiem `gx, `al ni y`i `tyx le lware aiem `gx `io le lcgez dzrpiz lbnxi ayail kj.
exy`i ldylim dzrpiz arxa yaz rc v`z dkekaim. e`m wal rlie dzrpiz anpgd gia de` ldyline, kne dnwal rlie zrpiz ay`x inez dyaer ygia de` ldyline rc v`z dkekaim.

elti fd iy lenx azpex ylpe yiy rlie nrfiad, y`s `m `ipe bxes ewhem, eko zpex aiz dgxs y`ipe bxes ewhem, e`tle d`y azeke nzx lzo rl baie ayaz `s rl ti ydic qelcz ym kl nd ynzx lzo rl ti wcxd dhnepd rl bai dbglim, kieo ydnrfiad ntqwz aio d`y ldwcxd ydzayil azekd.

enkl nwem, `m iecr ydpkxi iqiw `gx kj `z dzpex lgnm `z daiz, yfde nzx ayaz rl cxj yiza`x aqno xr"e, ekyizgnm dzpex n`c izgnm bm ko dzayil y`vle rc ydic qelcz ae `qex ldpige ym, `l` ihlpe nym wcm yiqiw dpkxi, lti yfde k`gc npig `z dwcxd e`gc pezo `z d`ex yzgzid, ydx`yeo thex `al `qex ncaxi qetxim:
kg `al nzx lenx lpkxi yipig ym `z dzayil, e`gx kj iqiw dzpex lgnm daiz, epxzg dzayil n`lie, lti yrwx kepz dpkxi adqiwe `ipd ayail dzayil, `l` ayail gnem daiz, yde` cax dnzx, edzayil pxzg n`lie. e`s yde` tqiw xiyd el` inez `io afd `qex a`nixd lpkxi, nhrm ypza`x lnrld.

ednpdb kqax` dx`yepd. enkl nwem, kl arl pty ignix lrvne anwem y`io ym vxj kl kj:
kh `al `m pzo pkxi nim lzej dwcxd dwaerd azpex kci yl` zawr kyiqiw dzpex, e`gx kj dqiw dzpex epxzge dnim nzx ldpez diyx`l ndm ayaz.
e`tle lkzgld nzx lenx le yizo nim awcxd wcm yiqiw dzpex lcaxi dkl, ydxi `io kepze kll lgnm dnim `l` lgnm daiz, y`io pezpim nim awcxd `l` kci yl` zawr dwcxd.
(enkl nwem, `m diyx`l gtu a`ezo dnim yizgnne ldcig adm klim `qex lenx lpkxi yizpm lwcxd, ckieo ydiyx`l arvne `qex le lzpm ym `tle qnej lgykd `m gtu adm ldcgz klim), nyem bfxd yn` igzd abglim l`gx yiqw dzpex kne yiza`x aqno xp"c `qex lenx lpkxi lzpm ym, ykl cax ncaxim `le ypza`xe aqno fd y`qex lryeze nyem bfxd yn` igzd, `e nyem ypx`d knayl azgld `qex lenx lpkxi lryeze. e`tle `m `io le gtu kll anim yizgnne `qex le lzo dnim arvne `tle wcm ydqw dzpex:
elti dnpdb ypdbe kqax` dx`yepd (cqris k"g), `s `m kepze apzipz dnim kci lgnnm nzx, kieo yrwx kepze adqiwe de` ayail daiz.
e`m pzo dnim awcxd l`gx ydqiw dzpex, `s rl ti ydizd dwcxd veppz rcio kypzo ad dnim, `m icer aaxex ypzpo kci lgnnm dxi dm `qexim rc nev`i yaz akci yirye lcaxi dkl, kcio pkxi yryd nl`kd bnexd ayail iyx`l, `al no dqzm l` pzpo `l` kci yl` zawr dwcxd:
` kax pza`x aqno xp"b yayx gi nzx ldydeze qnej lgykd `tle azpex y`ipe bxes ewhem. and caxim `nexim? anayl awcxd, y`ipd nndxz ldzayl, enqig crze nnpd rc lngx, eakl dlild ikeld ldzayl al` gzei abglim, ede` dcio avli ypvld awcxd.
`al avli y`vl dbglim `e yrl bai dbglim `qex ldydeze ym, `tle de` gi, e`tle `m de` azpex ekqd ti dzpex, lti ydvli y`io wcxd ntqwz aipe lbglim nndx de` lvlez, eiekl ldbnx yid` x`ei lqrcz dlild, eiy lgey yn` iykg yde` yaz eiqix kqei dzpex eigzd abglim lbnex vlize.
`l` `m ko hg ahih qaia dkqei, y`f `io geyyim yn` ihxg kl kj lqzex dhgei el` ifkex rl dyaz, ltikj nzx ldydeze azeke aio vli yrl bai dbglim, aio nayl awcxd, aio gi lbnxi, aio ydzgil lvlez `e ldzayl el` pvld epzayl rcio kn`kl ao cxeq`i:
a ekl fd aayx yex erf `e `il bcel ekiev` adm nnipim yayxm wyd e`io dxeg nfiw le, `al ayx bci eres ekiev` adm nnipim yayxm xj edxeg nfiw le nzx lvleze rl dbglim `e `vl dbglim azej dzpex nkqd `s rl ti y`ipe heg ahih, aio yde` gi lbnxi aio ydzgil lvlez el` pvld kn`kl ao cxeq`i, lti yaec`i l` ibld ti dzpex kci lgzez abglim, kieo ydxeg nfiw layx.

enkl nwem, `m pvld narec iem nypi vccie kn`kl ao cxeq`i nzx ldydeze `tle de` ylm, e`tle ayx yex erf, e`tle geu lzpex rl dbglim `e `vl dbglim.
e`s ld`eqxim ldydez wcxd akixd y`ipd bxetd ewhend kl fno ynvhnw eitd le, nkl nwem avli ynpg rl bai dbglim nny necim dm ynzx kypvld kn`kl ao cxeq`i narec iem, ckieo ydbir ln`kl ao cxeq`i, `m igzd abglim igxej dayx.
`al avli y`ipe rl bai dbglim nny `qex ldydeze ym, `l` `m ko pvld kl kj narec iem rc yde` nvhnw exr le, ld`eqxim ym ldydez wcxd rl bai kixd kl fno ynvhnw eitd le.

xw yvxij lfdx yinzio ldqix dayx nrl bai dbglim ayaz rc l`gx ykae dbglim, yl` ikad klem aqlewe dayx yrlidm, y`ipe cend lwcxd ynzx lqlwd nrl bai dbglim ayaz kne ypza`x aqno xp"b, lti y`io dwcxd nkad `ezm kll, `al dayx nkad `ezm wvz (andl dpehs nnpe) aqlewe ndm:

(enkl nwem, `m pzpm ym wcm ydqw dzpex `tyx yiy ldwl `m did yebb):
